instructions_en: Lie sideways on a 45-degree back extension bench with your hip on the pad, feet secured and hands crossed on your chest.
Lower your torso sideways toward the floor under control, keeping your body in line without twisting.
Use your obliques to raise your torso until it is in line with your legs or slightly above; then switch sides.

decisions.name: Alternate Lateral Pulldown
decisions.reason: Alternating two-handle pulldown; library has only the two-hand and single-arm versions.

instructions_en: Sit facing a dual high-pulley station, thighs secured, holding a handle in each hand with arms extended overhead.
Pull one handle down to shoulder level, driving that elbow toward your side while the other arm stays extended.
Return under control and repeat with the other arm, alternating every rep.

decisions.name: Assisted Chest Dip (Kneeling)
decisions.reason: Kneeling assisted dip machine; same as wger-1372 Triceps Dips (Assisted), chest lean is only a cue.

decisions.name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise With Throw Down
decisions.reason: Partner throw-down drill with an explosive leg swing; not a gym exercise worth programming.

decisions.name: Assisted Hanging Knee Raise
decisions.reason: Hanging knee raise; the 'assisted' tag adds no material difference.

decisions.name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Lateral Throw Down
decisions.reason: Partner throw-down leg raise drill; not a programmable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Assisted Lying Leg Raise With Throw Down
decisions.reason: Partner throw-down leg raise drill; not a programmable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Assisted Parallel Close Grip Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Assisted close neutral-grip pull-up; the library counts assisted as the same lift (see Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up).

decisions.name: Assisted Prone Hamstring
decisions.reason: Partner-assisted prone hamstring curl; same as Prone Manual Hamstring.

decisions.name: Assisted Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Assisted pull-up machine; the library entry is Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up.

decisions.name: Assisted Standing Triceps Extension (With Towel)
decisions.reason: Towel overhead triceps extension; same as Standing Towel Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Assisted Triceps Dip (Kneeling)
decisions.reason: Same triceps dip on the assisted dip machine as wger-1372; the knee pad is the standard setup.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding a barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width overhand grip.
Bend your elbows and lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel your lats stretch.
Pull the bar back over your face to your lower chest, then press it straight up to lockout.

decisions.name: Barbell Alternate Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: Alternating arms is not possible with a single barbell; mislabelled standard barbell curl.

decisions.name: Barbell Decline Bent Arm Pullover
decisions.reason: Decline bench with bent arms and shoulder-width grip; library has the flat bent-arm and the wide-grip straight-arm decline pullovers (compare later edb-1255).

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with your legs secured and hold a barbell over your chest with elbows bent.
Keeping that elbow angle, lower the bar in an arc behind your head until your lats stretch.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same arc, squeezing your lats.

decisions.name: Barbell Decline Close Grip To Skull Press
decisions.reason: Same decline close-grip bench press to skull crusher.

decisions.name: Barbell Decline Wide-Grip Press
decisions.reason: Same wide-grip decline barbell bench press.

decisions.name: Barbell Front Chest Squat
decisions.reason: Squat with the barbell racked on the front of the chest is the front squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Press
decisions.reason: Underhand grip on an incline bench; not in the library (later source twin edb-1257).

instructions_en: Lie on an incline bench and grip the bar underhand, slightly wider than shoulder width; use a spotter.
Unrack and lower the bar to your upper chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press the bar back up over your shoulders until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Barbell Incline Row
decisions.reason: Chest-supported on an incline bench; differs from the flat-bench Seal Row and the T-bar version (later twin lift-chestSupportedRow:barbell).

instructions_en: Set an incline bench to about 45 degrees and lie face down with your chest on the pad.
Hold a barbell below you with an overhand grip, slightly wider than shoulder width, arms straight.
Row the bar up toward the bench, squeeze your shoulder blades together, then lower with control.

decisions.name: Barbell Jm Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same JM press.

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Close-Grip Press
decisions.reason: Lying close-grip barbell press is the close-grip bench press.

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Close-Grip Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Lying barbell triceps extension to the forehead is the Lying Triceps Press (skull crusher).

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Extension
decisions.reason: Same lying barbell triceps extension (skull crusher).

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Lifting (On Hip)
decisions.reason: Lying hip lift with a barbell on the hips is the barbell glute bridge.

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Prone barbell curl with the arms over the bench end is the Lying High Bench Barbell Curl.

decisions.name: Barbell One Arm Bent Over Row
decisions.reason: Rowing a full barbell held at its centre with one hand is impractical; single-arm rows exist with dumbbell, landmine and cable.

decisions.name: Barbell Prone Incline Curl
decisions.reason: Prone incline barbell curl is the same exercise.

decisions.name: Barbell Pullover
decisions.reason: Arms kept straight; the library has only the bent-arm barbell pullover (matching its straight- and bent-arm dumbbell pair).

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench and hold a barbell over your chest with a shoulder-width grip and nearly straight arms.
Keeping your arms long, lower the bar in an arc behind your head until you feel a stretch in your lats.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same arc without bending your elbows further.

decisions.name: Barbell Rear Delt Raise
decisions.reason: A straight-arm rear-delt raise is not workable with a fixed bar; barbell rear-delt work is covered by Barbell Rear Delt Row.

decisions.name: Barbell Rear Lunge V. 2
decisions.reason: Barbell reverse (step-back) lunge, same as wger-1830; 'v. 2' is only a source variant.

decisions.name: Barbell Revers Wrist Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: Seated palms-down barbell wrist curl; 'v. 2' adds nothing.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Seated palms-down barbell wrist curl over the thighs.

decisions.name: Barbell Rollerout From Bench
decisions.reason: Same barbell rollout from a bench.

decisions.name: Barbell Rollerout
decisions.reason: Kneeling barbell rollout.

decisions.name: Barbell Seated Behind Head Military Press
decisions.reason: Seated; the library has only the standing behind-the-neck press.

instructions_en: Sit on an upright bench with the bar racked behind your head and grip it wider than shoulder width.
Unrack and lower the bar behind your head to about ear level, or as far as your shoulders comfortably allow.
Press the bar straight up to full lockout, keeping your torso upright, then lower it under control.

decisions.name: Barbell Seated Bradford Rocky Press
decisions.reason: The library Bradford/Rocky Press is already the seated version.

decisions.name: Barbell Seated Overhead Press
decisions.reason: Seated barbell overhead press is the seated barbell military press.

decisions.name: Barbell Side Bent V. 2
decisions.reason: 'v. 2' of the barbell side bend.

decisions.name: Barbell Side Split Squat V. 2
decisions.reason: 'v. 2' of the barbell side split squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Single Leg Split Squat
decisions.reason: Rear-foot-elevated barbell split squat is the library One Leg Barbell Squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Skier
decisions.reason: Unclear jumping barbell 'skier' move; not a recognisable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Barbell Squat (On Knees)
decisions.reason: Barbell squat on the knees is the kneeling squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Ab Rollerout
decisions.reason: The library Barbell Ab Rollout is already the version from the feet.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Back Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same standing behind-the-back barbell wrist curl.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Same standing barbell calf raise.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Reverse Grip Curl
decisions.reason: Standing reverse-grip barbell curl is the Reverse Barbell Curl.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Rocking Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Same rocking standing barbell calf raise.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Twist
decisions.reason: Standing; the library has only the seated barbell twist.

instructions_en: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and a light barbell across your upper back, hands holding it wide.
Brace your abs and slowly rotate your shoulders to one side while your hips keep facing forward.
Return to centre under control and repeat to the other side; avoid swinging the bar.

decisions.name: Barbell Straight Leg Deadlift
decisions.reason: Straight-leg barbell deadlift is the stiff-legged deadlift.

decisions.name: Barbell Upright Row V. 2
decisions.reason: 'v. 2' of the barbell upright row.

decisions.name: Barbell Upright Row V. 3
decisions.reason: 'v. 3' of the barbell upright row.

decisions.name: Barbell Wide Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same wide-grip barbell bench press.

decisions.name: Barbell Wide-Grip Upright Row
decisions.reason: Wide grip shifts work to the side delts; the library upright row uses a close grip.

instructions_en: Stand holding a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip well wider than shoulder width.
Lead with your elbows and pull the bar up close to your body until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor.
Pause briefly, then lower the bar slowly to the start.

decisions.name: Barbell Wide Squat
decisions.reason: Wide barbell squat is the wide-stance barbell squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Wrist Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: Seated palms-up barbell wrist curl; 'v. 2' adds nothing.

decisions.name: Bench Dip (Knees Bent)
decisions.reason: Bench dip with knees bent is only an easier foot position of the bench dip.

decisions.name: Bench Hip Extension
decisions.reason: Unloaded hip thrust with the upper back on a bench; the library has the floor bridge and the barbell hip thrust (later twin lift-hipThrust:bodyweight).

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with your upper back against the edge of a bench, knees bent and feet flat.
Drive through your heels to lift your hips until your body is straight from shoulders to knees.
Squeeze your glutes at the top, then lower your hips under control.

decisions.name: Biceps Narrow Pull-Ups
decisions.reason: Narrow underhand pull-up is the Chin-Up, which the library already defines with a close grip.

decisions.name: Biceps Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Biceps-focused underhand pull-up is the Chin-Up.

decisions.name: Cable Alternate Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Alternating-arm variant only adds noise; single-arm cable triceps extensions are already in the library.

decisions.name: Cable Bar Lateral Pulldown
decisions.reason: Straight-bar cable lat pulldown is the Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Bench Press
decisions.reason: Lying on a flat bench between low pulleys; the library cable chest presses are seated or standing.

instructions_en: Place a flat bench between two low pulleys, lie back and hold a handle in each hand beside your chest.
Press the handles up and slightly together until your arms are straight over your chest.
Lower the handles slowly back to chest level, keeping your shoulder blades pinned to the bench.

decisions.name: Cable Concentration Extension (On Knee)
decisions.reason: Same single-arm cable triceps extension with the elbow braced on the knee (ek-0176).

instructions_en: Set both pulleys of a cable crossover high and kneel or sit between them, holding a handle in each hand.
From arms extended overhead, pull the handles down toward your shoulders, driving your elbows to your sides.
Squeeze your lats at the bottom, then let your arms rise slowly back overhead.

decisions.name: Cable Cross-Over Revers Fly
decisions.reason: Standing bent-over with both pulleys; the library has seated, single-arm and upright high-pulley versions.

instructions_en: Stand between two low pulleys, holding the left handle in your right hand and the right handle in your left.
Hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor, arms hanging with a slight elbow bend.
Raise your arms out to the sides to shoulder height, squeeze your rear delts, then lower slowly.

decisions.name: Cable Decline Fly
decisions.reason: Fly on a decline bench; the library cable flies are standing or on a flat or incline bench.

instructions_en: Set a decline bench between two low pulleys and lie back holding a handle in each hand over your chest.
With a slight bend in your elbows, open your arms wide in an arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Squeeze your chest to bring the handles back together over your lower chest.

decisions.name: Cable Decline Seated Wide-Grip Row
decisions.reason: Same seated wide-grip cable row as edb-0218; 'decline' adds no identifiable difference.

decisions.name: Cable Floor Seated Wide-Grip Row
decisions.reason: Seated wide-grip cable row done sitting on the floor; same movement as edb-0218.

decisions.name: Cable Forward Raise
decisions.reason: Cable forward raise is the cable front raise.

decisions.name: Cable Front Shoulder Raise
decisions.reason: Same cable front raise.

decisions.name: Cable High Row (Kneeling)
decisions.reason: Same kneeling high-pulley cable row; the attachment does not change it.

decisions.name: Cable Incline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Cable press on an incline bench is the Incline Cable Chest Press.

decisions.name: Cable Kneeling Crunch
decisions.reason: Kneeling cable crunch is the library Cable Crunch.

decisions.name: Cable Lateral Pulldown (With Rope Attachment)
decisions.reason: Rope lat pulldown is a neutral close-grip pulldown, not commonly separated from the V-Bar Pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Standing cable lateral raise is already in the library as the single-arm version.

decisions.name: Cable Low Fly
decisions.reason: Cable fly from the low pulleys is the Low-to-High Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Low Seated Row
decisions.reason: Low-pulley seated cable row is the Seated Cable Row.

decisions.name: Cable Lying Close-Grip Curl
decisions.reason: Same lying close-grip cable bar curl.

decisions.name: Cable Lying Extension Pullover (With Rope Attachment)

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench with your head toward a low pulley and hold a rope attachment behind your head.
With elbows slightly bent, pull the rope in an arc over your face until your hands are above your chest.
Return slowly along the same arc until you feel a stretch in your lats.

decisions.name: Cable Lying Fly
decisions.reason: Cable fly lying on a flat bench is the Flat Bench Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Lying Triceps Extension V. 2
decisions.reason: 'v. 2' of the cable lying triceps extension.

decisions.name: Cable Middle Fly
decisions.reason: Chest-height standing cable fly is the Cable Chest Fly.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Bent Over Row
decisions.reason: Standing bent-over; the library single-arm cable row is seated.

instructions_en: Stand facing a low pulley, hinge forward with a flat back and hold the handle in one hand, arm extended.
Row the handle toward your hip, keeping your elbow close to your side as your shoulder blade pulls back.
Lower with control until your arm is straight; finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Curl
decisions.reason: Same standing single-arm cable curl.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Lateral Bent-Over
decisions.reason: Single-arm bent-over cable raise is the Bent Over Low-Pulley Side Lateral.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Straight Back High Row (Kneeling)
decisions.reason: Same kneeling single-arm high-pulley row.

decisions.name: Cable Overhead Triceps Extension (Rope Attachment)
decisions.reason: Same rope overhead cable triceps extension.

decisions.name: Cable Pull Through (With Rope)
decisions.reason: Same cable pull-through with a rope.

decisions.name: Cable Pulldown (Pro Lat Bar)
decisions.reason: Lat pulldown with a lat bar attachment is the Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Pulldown
decisions.reason: Cable pulldown is the Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Pushdown (Straight Arm) V. 2
decisions.reason: Straight-arm cable pushdown is the Straight-Arm Pulldown; 'v. 2' adds nothing.

decisions.name: Cable Pushdown (With Rope Attachment)
decisions.reason: Same triceps rope pushdown.

decisions.name: Cable Pushdown
decisions.reason: Same straight-bar triceps pushdown.

decisions.name: Cable Rear Delt Row (Stirrups)
decisions.reason: Rear-delt cable row with stirrup handles instead of a rope; attachment does not make it a different exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Rear Drive
decisions.reason: Obscure cable 'rear drive' with no clear, recognisable technique; cable kickbacks cover the movement.

decisions.name: Cable Rear Pulldown
decisions.reason: Cable rear pulldown is the pulldown behind the neck.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse-Grip Pushdown
decisions.reason: Same reverse-grip triceps pushdown.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse-Grip Straight Back Seated High Row
decisions.reason: Seated underhand pull from the high pulley is the underhand cable pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Overhand grip on the cable; the library has the underhand cable preacher curl and the barbell reverse preacher curl.

instructions_en: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley with a straight bar and rest your upper arms on the pad.
Hold the bar with an overhand grip and curl it up, keeping your upper arms on the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are almost straight.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Palms-down grip; the library cable wrist curls are palms-up.

instructions_en: Sit facing a low pulley with a straight bar and rest your forearms on your thighs, palms down, wrists past your knees.
Lift the backs of your hands by extending your wrists as high as possible.
Lower the bar slowly, keeping your forearms still on your thighs.

decisions.name: Cable Seated High Row (V-Bar)
decisions.reason: Seated V-bar pull from the high pulley with a slight lean-back is the V-Bar Pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Seated One Arm Alternate Row
decisions.reason: Seated single-arm cable row; alternating sides is not a different exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Shoulder Internal Rotation
decisions.reason: Same seated cable shoulder internal rotation.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Wide-Grip Row
decisions.reason: Wide overhand bar grip; the library Seated Cable Row uses a close handle.

instructions_en: Sit at a low-pulley row station with a long bar attached and grip it overhand, hands wider than your shoulders.
With your chest up, row the bar to your lower chest, driving your elbows out and back.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together, then extend your arms slowly without rounding your back.

decisions.name: Cable Side Bend
decisions.reason: Low-pulley side bend; the library has only the high-pulley cable side bend.

instructions_en: Stand side-on to a low pulley, holding the handle in the near hand with your arm straight and feet hip-width apart.
Let the cable draw you into a slow side bend toward the machine, keeping your hips still.
Use your opposite obliques to pull yourself back upright; switch sides after the set.

decisions.name: Cable Side Crunch
decisions.reason: Cable side crunch is the one-arm high-pulley side bend.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Back Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Cable version; the library has only the barbell behind-the-back wrist curl.

instructions_en: Stand with your back to a low pulley and hold a straight bar behind your thighs, palms facing back.
Keeping your arms straight, curl your wrists to lift the bar as high as possible.
Lower the bar slowly until your wrists are fully extended.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Cross-Over High Reverse Fly
decisions.reason: Standing crossover reverse fly from high pulleys is the Cable Rear Delt Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Crunch
decisions.reason: Standing high-pulley cable crunch is the Standing Rope Crunch.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Fly
decisions.reason: Standing chest-height cable fly is the Cable Chest Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Hip Extension
decisions.reason: Same standing low-pulley ankle-cuff hip extension (cable glute kickback).

decisions.name: Cable Standing Inner Curl
decisions.reason: Source describes a standard standing underhand cable curl; 'inner' adds nothing identifiable.

decisions.name: Cable Standing One Arm Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same single-arm standing cable triceps extension; 'standing' is the normal position.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Pulldown (With Rope)
decisions.reason: Standing high-pulley rope pulled down to the thighs is the rope straight-arm pulldown.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Rear Delt Row (With Rope)
decisions.reason: Standing at a chest-height pulley; the library rope rear-delt row is seated at a low-row station, and Face Pull pulls to the face.

row.name_en: Cable Standing Rope Rear Delt Row
instructions_en: Set a rope on a pulley at chest height, hold both ends with palms facing in, and step back until your arms are straight.
Pull the rope toward your upper chest with elbows flared out at shoulder height, squeezing the rear shoulders and upper back.
Extend the arms slowly under control without letting the shoulders round forward.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Row (V-Bar)
decisions.reason: Standing row; the library only has seated and kneeling cable rows.

instructions_en: Attach a V-bar to a pulley at mid-torso height, grab it, and step back into a staggered stance with arms extended and core braced.
Row the handle to your lower ribs, driving the elbows back close to your sides and squeezing the shoulder blades together.
Return slowly until the arms are straight, keeping the torso upright and still.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Shoulder External Rotation
decisions.reason: Same standing elbow-height cable shoulder external rotation.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Twist Row (V-Bar)
decisions.reason: Gimmicky twisting variant of the standing V-bar row; not a standard programmed lift.

decisions.name: Cable Straight Back Seated Row
decisions.reason: A straight back is the normal seated cable row form; no material difference.

decisions.name: Cable Supine Reverse Fly
decisions.reason: Name (supine) and source setup (prone) conflict, so the movement cannot be identified with confidence; cable rear-delt flys already covered.

decisions.name: Cable Tuck Reverse Crunch
decisions.reason: Same lying low-pulley reverse crunch tucking the knees to the chest.

decisions.name: Cable Twist
decisions.reason: Standing horizontal rotation; Cable Russian Twists is done lying on a ball, wood chops and lifts are diagonal, and wger-672 is seated.

instructions_en: Set a single handle at chest height, stand side-on to the stack, and hold it with both hands, arms extended in front of your chest.
Keeping your hips facing forward and arms straight, rotate your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body.
Rotate back slowly under control, then switch sides after the set.

decisions.name: Cable Twisting Pull
decisions.reason: Vague 'twisting pull'; unclear, non-standard rotational row variant.

decisions.name: Cambered Bar Lying Row
decisions.reason: Same prone bench row with a cambered bar.

decisions.name: Chin-Ups (Narrow Parallel Grip)
decisions.reason: Narrow neutral-grip chin-up is the same movement as the V-bar pull-up.

decisions.name: Circles Knee Stretch
decisions.reason: Same standing knee-circle mobility drill.

decisions.name: Crunch Floor
decisions.reason: Same basic floor crunch.

decisions.name: Decline Sit-Up
decisions.reason: Full sit-up range on a decline bench; library has the floor Sit-Up and the partial-range Decline Crunch.

instructions_en: Hook your feet under the pads of a decline bench and lie back with arms crossed over your chest or hands lightly beside your head.
Curl your torso all the way up until your chest approaches your thighs, without pulling on your neck.
Lower your back down slowly to the bench without dropping.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Alternate Side Press
decisions.reason: Source describes a standing alternating dumbbell overhead press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Arnold Press V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the Arnold press; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Around Pullover
decisions.reason: Same lying straight-arm dumbbell pullover arcing behind the head.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Bench Seated Press
decisions.reason: Same seated dumbbell shoulder press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Bent-Over Row
decisions.reason: Same single-arm bent-over dumbbell row; support setup is a minor difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline Hammer Press
decisions.reason: Neutral grip on a decline bench; library has neutral-grip flat and incline presses and a pronated decline press only.

instructions_en: Secure your legs on a decline bench and lie back holding dumbbells above your lower chest, palms facing each other.
Lower the dumbbells to the sides of your chest, keeping the elbows tucked close to your torso.
Press the dumbbells back up until the arms are straight, without clashing them at the top.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of a prone 45-degree bench shrug; same exercise as the incline shrug.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline Shrug
decisions.reason: Source 'decline' setup is chest-down on a 45-degree bench, the same as the incline shrug.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline Twist Fly
decisions.reason: Decline fly with a wrist-twist cue; no material difference from the decline dumbbell fly.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Front Raise V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the standing dumbbell front raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Full Can Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Full-can raise (thumbs up, scapular plane) is the same as dumbbell scaption.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the dumbbell hammer curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Breeding
decisions.reason: 'Breeding' is a mistranslation of fly; same incline dumbbell fly.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the incline dumbbell curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Hammer Press
decisions.reason: Same incline dumbbell press with a hammer (neutral) grip.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Palm-In Press
decisions.reason: Same incline palms-in dumbbell press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Raise
decisions.reason: Same dumbbell raise performed lying back on an incline bench.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Rear Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Same chest-down incline-bench rear lateral raise (reverse fly).

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Row
decisions.reason: Same chest-supported incline-bench dumbbell row.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Shrug
decisions.reason: Chest-supported prone shrug (elevation); differs from the standing Dumbbell Shrug and the retraction-only Middle Back Shrug.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a bench set to about 45 degrees, holding a dumbbell in each hand with arms hanging straight down.
Shrug your shoulders up toward your ears and slightly back, keeping the arms straight.
Pause briefly, then lower the shoulders slowly into a full stretch.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Twisted Flyes
decisions.reason: Same incline dumbbell fly with a twist.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Kickback
decisions.reason: Same two-arm bent-over dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Extension (Across Face)
decisions.reason: Same lying cross-face dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Elbow Press
decisions.reason: Source describes a lying neutral-grip dumbbell triceps extension; no distinct movement.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Femoral
decisions.reason: 'Femoral' means leg curl; dumbbell version on a flat bench, while the library only has machine leg curls.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a flat bench with your knees just past the end and a dumbbell held securely between your feet.
Curl your heels toward your glutes, keeping your hips pressed into the bench and the dumbbell squeezed between your feet.
Lower slowly until the legs are nearly straight; start light and have someone place the dumbbell if needed.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Hammer Press
decisions.reason: Same flat neutral-grip dumbbell bench press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Deltoid Rear
decisions.reason: Same prone single-arm rear lateral raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Press V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the single-arm flat dumbbell bench press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Press
decisions.reason: Same single-arm flat dumbbell bench press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Pronated Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same lying single-arm pronated triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying One Arm Supinated Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same lying single-arm supinated triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Kickback
decisions.reason: Same single-arm bent-over dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Same standing single-arm dumbbell lateral raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Lateral Raise With Support
decisions.reason: Same single-arm lateral raise holding a support; nothing else changes.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same seated single-arm palms-down wrist curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Fly (With Support)
decisions.reason: Single-arm seated bent-over fly braced with the free hand; library has the two-arm seated version and a prone single-arm raise.

instructions_en: Sit on the end of a bench, hinge forward with a flat back, and brace your free hand on the bench or your knee.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbell out to the side until the arm is level with your shoulder.
Lower slowly without swinging, finish all reps, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Shoulder Press V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the single-arm dumbbell shoulder press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Triceps Extension (On Bench)
decisions.reason: Same seated single-arm overhead dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same seated single-arm palms-up wrist curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Neutral Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Thumb-up (neutral) wrist movement; the library only has palms-up and palms-down wrist curls.

instructions_en: Kneel facing a flat bench and rest both forearms on it, thumbs up, hands past the edge, each holding a dumbbell.
Keeping the forearms still, tilt the wrists to lift the front of the dumbbells upward as far as comfortable.
Lower slowly to a full stretch and repeat.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Neutral Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Single-arm version of the over-bench neutral-grip wrist curl; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Single-arm over-bench wrist curl; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Revers Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same over-bench palms-down (reverse) wrist curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same over-bench palms-up wrist curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Peacher Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Same dumbbell preacher hammer curl (typo 'Peacher').

decisions.name: Dumbbell Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Same two-arm dumbbell preacher curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Pronate-Grip Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same pronated-grip dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Rear Delt Row_shoulder
decisions.reason: Same bent-over dumbbell rear delt row.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Rear Fly
decisions.reason: Standing unsupported bent-over reverse fly; library versions are incline-prone, seated, lying or head-supported, and Dumbbell Flyes is a chest move.

instructions_en: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other, soften the knees, and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel to the floor.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the dumbbells out to the sides to shoulder height, squeezing the rear shoulders.
Lower slowly while keeping the back flat and the torso still.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise (Support Head)
decisions.reason: Same bent-over rear delt raise with the head on a bench.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Rear Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Same standing bent-over dumbbell rear lateral raise as the rear fly.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Revers Grip Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: Same standing dumbbell reverse-grip curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Pronated grip on the preacher bench; differs from the supinated dumbbell preacher curl, and the library reverse preacher curl is barbell.

instructions_en: Sit at a preacher bench with your upper arms on the pad, holding dumbbells with palms facing down.
Curl the dumbbells up by bending the elbows, keeping the wrists straight and upper arms flat on the pad.
Lower slowly to almost full extension without letting the elbows lift.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same seated two-arm palms-down wrist curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Rotation Reverse Fly
decisions.reason: Same reverse fly with rotation of the arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Front Raise
decisions.reason: Alternating arms on the seated dumbbell front raise; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Press
decisions.reason: Alternating arms on the seated dumbbell press; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Bench Extension
decisions.reason: Same seated two-hand overhead dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Front Raise
decisions.reason: Seated position; the library dumbbell front raises are all standing.

instructions_en: Sit upright on the end of a bench with feet flat, holding dumbbells beside your thighs with palms facing down.
Raise both dumbbells forward with nearly straight arms until they reach shoulder height.
Lower slowly without leaning back or swinging.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Kickback
decisions.reason: Same seated bent-over two-arm dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' of the seated dumbbell lateral raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Same seated dumbbell lateral raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Seated forearms-on-thighs version of the neutral-grip wrist curl; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Kickback
decisions.reason: Same seated bent-over single-arm dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated One Arm Rotate
decisions.reason: Ambiguous: unclear whether it is a forearm rotation or a shoulder external rotation; both are already in the library.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Preacher curls are always seated; same single-arm dumbbell preacher curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Revers Grip Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Pronated grip; the library concentration curls are all supinated.

instructions_en: Sit on a bench with legs apart and brace the back of your upper arm against the inner thigh, holding a dumbbell palm down.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the palm facing down and the upper arm still.
Lower slowly to full extension, then switch arms after the set.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press (Parallel Grip)
decisions.reason: Seated with a neutral grip; the library palms-in press is standing and the seated presses use a pronated grip.

instructions_en: Sit on an upright bench with back support, holding dumbbells at shoulder height with palms facing each other.
Press the dumbbells straight overhead until the arms are extended, keeping the palms facing in.
Lower under control back to shoulder height.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Shoulder Press
decisions.reason: Same seated dumbbell shoulder press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Side Lying One Hand Raise
decisions.reason: Side-lying flat; the library one-arm incline lateral raise is on an incline bench and the lying one-arm raise is prone.

instructions_en: Lie on your side on a flat bench or the floor, head supported, holding a dumbbell in your top hand in front of the thigh.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the arm up and out until it is just short of vertical.
Lower slowly to the start, finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Standing single-leg; the library dumbbell calf raises are two-legged or seated.

instructions_en: Stand on one foot on the edge of a step, holding a dumbbell on the same side and steadying yourself with the other hand.
Lower the heel below the step for a full stretch, then rise as high as possible onto the ball of the foot.
Pause at the top, lower slowly, then switch legs after the set.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Split Squat
decisions.reason: Rear-foot-elevated single-leg split squat with dumbbells is the Bulgarian split squat.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Squat
decisions.reason: Free-standing single-leg squat with dumbbells; the split squat keeps the rear foot down and the library pistol squat is Smith-only.

instructions_en: Stand on one leg holding dumbbells at your sides, with the other leg lifted slightly in front of you.
Sit the hips back and bend the standing knee to lower as deep as you can control, keeping the knee over the toes.
Drive through the whole foot to stand back up, then switch legs after the set.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Overhead Press
decisions.reason: Same standing alternating dumbbell overhead press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Raise
decisions.reason: Source describes alternating standing lateral raises; no material difference from the dumbbell lateral raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: Same standing dumbbell biceps curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Front Raise Above Head
decisions.reason: Same standing straight-arm front raise above the head.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Kickback
decisions.reason: Standing is the normal position; same two-arm dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Same standing single-arm concentration curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Extension
decisions.reason: Same standing single-arm overhead dumbbell triceps extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing One Arm Reverse Curl
decisions.reason: Single-arm version of the standing dumbbell reverse curl; no material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Overhead Press
decisions.reason: Same standing dumbbell overhead press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Same two-arm dumbbell curl over a preacher pad; standing behind the pad does not change the movement.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Stiff Leg Deadlift
decisions.reason: Same as the library Stiff-Legged Dumbbell Deadlift (word order only).

decisions.name: Dumbbell Straight Leg Deadlift
decisions.reason: Straight-leg and stiff-leg dumbbell deadlift are the same lift.

decisions.name: Dumbbell W-Press
decisions.reason: Named press from a low, tucked-elbow W start with scapular retraction; differs from the standard dumbbell shoulder press setup.

instructions_en: Sit tall on an upright bench holding dumbbells just outside your shoulders, elbows tucked down near your ribs in a W shape.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together and press the dumbbells overhead until your arms are straight.
Lower slowly back to the W position, keeping your shoulder blades pulled back.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Anti Gravity Press
decisions.reason: Same prone incline-bench anti-gravity press; EZ-bar instead of straight bar is not material.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Decline Close Grip Face Press
decisions.reason: Lowering a close-grip EZ bar to the face on a decline bench is the library Decline EZ Bar Triceps Extension.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Incline Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same incline-bench overhead triceps extension; EZ-bar vs straight bar is incidental here.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Jm Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same JM press; EZ-bar instead of straight bar is not material.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Reverse Grip Curl
decisions.reason: Free-standing EZ-bar reverse curl; closest is a cable curl, and the library reverse curl uses a straight bar (EZ and straight-bar curls are listed separately).

instructions_en: Stand holding an EZ-bar on the angled grips with palms facing down, arms straight and elbows at your sides.
Curl the bar toward your shoulders, keeping your wrists straight and upper arms still.
Lower it slowly until your arms are fully straight.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: The library Reverse Barbell Preacher Curls is already done with an EZ-bar and pronated grip.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Seated Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Seated overhead barbell triceps extension (everkinetic twin); EZ-bar vs straight bar is incidental.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Spider Curl
decisions.reason: The library Spider Curl is already an EZ-bar curl over the vertical side of a preacher bench.

decisions.name: Flexion Leg Sit Up (Bent Knee)
decisions.reason: A bent-knee sit-up is the library Sit-Up.

decisions.name: Flexion Leg Sit Up (Straight Arm)
decisions.reason: Sit-up with arms reaching forward; arm position only, same exercise.

decisions.name: Floor Fly (With Barbell)
decisions.reason: Same push-up-position fly rolling barbells apart on the floor.

decisions.name: Front Plank With Twist
decisions.reason: Adds a hip rotation for the obliques; a static front plank has no twist.

instructions_en: Hold a forearm plank with elbows under your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
Rotate your hips to lower one hip toward the floor without touching it.
Return through the center and rotate to the other side, keeping your shoulders steady.

decisions.name: Gironda Sternum Chin
decisions.reason: Same as the library Gironda Sternum Chins (plural only).

decisions.name: Gorilla Chin
decisions.reason: Same as the library Gorilla Chin/Crunch.

decisions.name: Groin Crunch
decisions.reason: Crunch with soles together and knees out is the library Frog Sit-Ups.

decisions.name: Hanging Straight Leg Hip Raise
decisions.reason: Straight-leg hanging leg raise is the library Hanging Leg Raise.

decisions.name: Hanging Straight Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Same as the library Hanging Leg Raise (done with straight legs).

decisions.name: Hanging Straight Twisting Leg Hip Raise
decisions.reason: Adds a rotation to each side; differs from the straight hanging leg raise.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip and your legs straight together.
Raise your straight legs up and toward one side, rotating your pelvis so your feet travel past that hip.
Lower under control without swinging, then alternate sides.

decisions.name: Hyperextension (On Bench)
decisions.reason: Back extension with hips off the end of a flat bench is the library row.

instructions_en: Lie on your back on a decline bench with your head at the high end, holding the bench behind your head.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until vertical, then curl your hips off the bench.
Lower your hips and legs slowly, stopping before your feet touch the bench.

decisions.name: Incline Twisting Sit-Up
decisions.reason: Twisting trunk curl on the slanted sit-up bench is the library Decline Oblique Crunch.

decisions.name: Inverse Leg Curl (Bench Support)
decisions.reason: Nordic-style hamstring curl with ankles anchored on a bench is the library Natural Glute Ham Raise.

decisions.name: Inverted Row V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the library Inverted Row.

instructions_en: From standing, squat, place your hands on the floor and jump your feet back into a plank.
Jump your feet back to your hands and stand up.
Do one jumping jack, then go straight into the next rep.

decisions.name: Kick Out Sit
decisions.reason: Animal-flow style kick-through drill; not a recognisable programmable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Landmine 180
decisions.reason: Same as the library Landmine 180's.

decisions.name: Lever Alternating Narrow Grip Seated Row
decisions.reason: Alternating arms on the iso-lateral lever row machine is the library Leverage Iso Row.

decisions.name: Lever Assisted Chin-Up
decisions.reason: Underhand grip on the assisted machine; the library has only the assisted pull-up and the unassisted chin-up.

instructions_en: Set the assistance, kneel or stand on the platform and grip the handles with palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Pull until your chin passes the handles, driving your elbows down toward your ribs.
Lower slowly until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Lever Back Extension
decisions.reason: Seated selectorized/lever machine; the library has only bench-based back extensions.

instructions_en: Sit in the back extension machine with the pad across your upper back and your feet on the footplate.
Push your torso back against the pad in a smooth arc until your body is upright or slightly reclined.
Return slowly to the start without letting the weight stack touch down.

decisions.name: Lever Front Pulldown
decisions.reason: Lever machine pulldown; closest match (Front Lever) is an unrelated gymnastics hold, and the library Lat Pulldown is cable.

instructions_en: Sit at the pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads and grip the handles overhand, slightly wider than your shoulders.
Pull the handles down to your upper chest, driving your elbows toward your sides.
Let the handles rise slowly until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Lever Gripless Shrug
decisions.reason: Same lever machine shrug; a gripless pad only removes the grip demand.

decisions.name: Lever Kneeling Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Kneeling single-leg machine; the library has lying, seated and standing leg curls.

instructions_en: Kneel on the machine with one knee on the pad, forearms on the support and the working ankle under the roller.
Curl your heel toward your glutes, keeping your hips still.
Lower slowly until the knee is almost straight, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Lever Kneeling Twist
decisions.reason: Resisted torso rotation on a rotary torso machine; kneeling vs seated pads is a machine-design detail.

decisions.name: Lever Military Press
decisions.reason: Lever (plate-loaded) military press is the library Leverage Shoulder Press.

decisions.name: Lever Narrow Grip Seated Row
decisions.reason: Standard chest-supported machine row with the close neutral handles.

decisions.name: Lever One Arm Shoulder Press
decisions.reason: One arm at a time; the Leverage Shoulder Press is two-arm.

instructions_en: Sit in the shoulder press machine with your back on the pad and hold one handle at shoulder height.
Press the handle overhead until your arm is straight, without arching your back.
Lower it slowly to shoulder height, finish your reps, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Lever Overhand Triceps Dip
decisions.reason: Same seated dip machine; handle grip is not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Crunch (Chest Pad)
decisions.reason: Seated ab crunch machine; the chest-pad style is a machine detail.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Fly
decisions.reason: Seated machine fly is the library Butterfly (pec deck).

decisions.name: Lever Seated Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Same seated hip abduction machine as the library Thigh Abductor.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Hip Adduction
decisions.reason: Same seated hip adduction machine as the library Thigh Adductor.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Leg Raise Crunch
decisions.reason: The library Ab Crunch Machine already raises the legs while crunching the torso.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Reverse Fly (Parallel Grip)
decisions.reason: The library Reverse Machine Flyes already uses the parallel (palms-in) handles.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Reverse Fly
decisions.reason: Same seated reverse fly machine as the library Reverse Pec Deck.

decisions.name: Lying (Side) Quads Stretch
decisions.reason: Side-lying quad stretch is the library On Your Side Quad Stretch.

decisions.name: March Sit (Wall)
decisions.reason: Adds alternating foot lifts to the wall sit, loading one leg at a time.

instructions_en: Lean your back against a wall and slide down until your knees are bent about 90 degrees, feet hip-width apart.
Lift one foot a few inches off the floor while holding the squat position.
Set it down and lift the other foot, alternating without letting your hips rise.

decisions.name: Mixed Grip Chin-Up
decisions.reason: Same as the library Mixed Grip Chin.

decisions.name: Monster Walk
decisions.reason: Monster walk depends on a resistance band (excluded equipment); without it it is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Olympic Barbell Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Hammer (neutral) grip is not possible on a straight Olympic barbell; movement cannot be identified.

decisions.name: Olympic Barbell Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Standing overhead barbell triceps extension is already in the library.

decisions.name: One Arm Dip
decisions.reason: Single-arm bench dip is an awkward variant rarely programmed; bench dips are already in the library.

decisions.name: Otis Up
decisions.reason: Same as the library Otis-Up.

decisions.name: Outside Leg Kick Push-Up
decisions.reason: Gimmicky push-up with a sideways leg kick; not a standard gym exercise.

decisions.name: Overhead Triceps Stretch
decisions.reason: Hand behind the head, pull the elbow: the library Triceps Stretch.

decisions.name: Push-Up (Wall) V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the wall push-up (wger Wall Pushup).

decisions.name: Push-Up Close-Grip Off Dumbbell
decisions.reason: Same as the library Close-Grip Push-Up off of a Dumbbell.

decisions.name: Push-Up Inside Leg Kick
decisions.reason: Gimmicky push-up with a leg kick; not a standard gym exercise.

decisions.name: Raise Single Arm Push-Up
decisions.reason: Push-up on one arm with the other held out is the library Single-Arm Push-Up.

decisions.name: Rear Decline Bridge
decisions.reason: Ambiguous name; the bridge variant cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Rear Deltoid Stretch
decisions.reason: Cross-body arm stretch is the library Shoulder Stretch.

decisions.name: Rear Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Rear (behind-the-neck) pull-up is the library Wide-Grip Rear Pull-Up.

decisions.name: Reverse Dip
decisions.reason: 'Reverse dip' is a common name for the bench dip.

decisions.name: Reverse Grip Machine Lat Pulldown
decisions.reason: Lever machine with underhand grip; the library Reverse-Grip Lat Pulldown is cable.

instructions_en: Sit at the pulldown machine with your thighs under the pads and grip the handles with palms facing you, about shoulder-width apart.
Pull the handles to your upper chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Return slowly until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Reverse Grip Pull-Up
decisions.reason: A shoulder-width underhand pull-up is the library Chin-Up.

decisions.name: Run (Equipment)
decisions.reason: Running is already covered by the library treadmill running row.

decisions.name: Seated Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Seated straight-leg raise; differs from the lying leg raise (position) and seated leg tucks (bent knees).

instructions_en: Sit on the end of a flat bench, lean back slightly and hold the sides of the bench.
Keeping your legs straight and together, raise them to about hip height.
Lower them slowly without letting your feet rest on the floor.

decisions.name: Seated Lower Back Stretch
decisions.reason: Seated forward fold; the library Chair Lower Back Stretch is a side bend.

instructions_en: Sit on the front of a chair with your feet flat and knees apart.
Slowly bend forward from the hips, letting your torso and arms hang between your knees.
Relax and breathe into your lower back, then roll up slowly.

decisions.name: Seated Side Crunch (Wall)
decisions.reason: Obscure seated side-bend against a wall; oblique crunches and side bends already cover it.

decisions.name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl (On Floor)
decisions.reason: Kneeling Nordic curl assisted by the hands is the library Floor Glute-Ham Raise.

decisions.name: Self Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Hand-assisted Nordic curl, same as the library Floor Glute-Ham Raise.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank with your hands under your shoulders and feet slightly wide.
Do a push-up, lowering your chest toward the floor and pressing back up.
At the top, tap one hand to the opposite shoulder with hips square, alternating sides each rep.

decisions.name: Side Bridge V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the library Side Bridge.

decisions.name: Side Hip (On Parallel Bars)
decisions.reason: Oblique version of the parallel-bar knee raise.

instructions_en: Support yourself on parallel bars or a captain's chair with your shoulders down and legs hanging.
Raise your bent knees up and toward one side, curling your pelvis so they finish beside your ribs.
Lower slowly without swinging and alternate sides.

decisions.name: Side Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Controlled bodyweight abduction; the library Side Leg Raises is a dynamic swing stretch.

instructions_en: Lie on your side with your legs straight and stacked, head resting on your lower arm.
Raise your top leg toward the ceiling, toes pointing forward and heel leading slightly back.
Lower slowly without letting your hips roll back, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Side Push Neck Stretch
decisions.reason: Same as the library Side Neck Stretch.

decisions.name: Side-To-Side Chin
decisions.reason: Same as the library Side To Side Chins.

decisions.name: Side Wrist Pull Stretch
decisions.reason: Same as the library Side Wrist Pull.

decisions.name: Single Leg Platform Slide
decisions.reason: The library Platform Hamstring Slides is already a single-leg slide curl.

decisions.name: Sit-Up V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the library Sit-Up.

decisions.name: Sled 45в° Calf Press
decisions.reason: Calf press on the 45-degree leg press is the library row.

decisions.name: Sled 45в° Leg Press
decisions.reason: The 45-degree sled leg press is the library Leg Press.

decisions.name: Sled 45в° Leg Wide Press
decisions.reason: Wide-stance leg press, same as wger Leg Presses (wide) (its bodyweight equipment tag is a mapping error).

decisions.name: Sled Closer Hack Squat
decisions.reason: Closer-stance sled hack squat is the library Narrow Stance Hack Squats.

decisions.name: Sled Forward Angled Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Standing calf raise on the angled hack sled, same as wger Calf Raises on Hackenschmitt Machine.

decisions.name: Sled Hack Squat
decisions.reason: Same as the library Hack Squat.

decisions.name: Sled Lying Squat
decisions.reason: Same as the library Lying Machine Squat.

decisions.name: Smith Back Shrug
decisions.reason: Same as the library Smith Machine Behind the Back Shrug.

instructions_en: Sit upright on a bench in a Smith machine with the bar behind your head and grip it slightly wider than your shoulders.
Unhook the bar and press it straight up until your arms are extended.
Lower it under control to about ear level behind your head.

decisions.name: Smith Bent Knee Good Morning
decisions.reason: Smith machine good morning with soft knees, same as everkinetic Good Mornings: Smith Machine.

decisions.name: Smith Chair Squat
decisions.reason: The library Chair Squat is this squat machine/Smith squat with feet forward.

decisions.name: Smith Decline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same as the library Decline Smith Press.

row.name_en: Smith Machine Decline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench in a Smith machine and grip the bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your lower chest, keeping your elbows close to your body.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

row.name_en: Smith Machine Incline Reverse-Grip Bench Press
instructions_en: Lie on an incline bench in a Smith machine and grip the bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your upper chest with your elbows tucked toward your sides.
Press it back up until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Smith Narrow Row
decisions.reason: Close grip; the library Smith Machine Bent Over Row uses a standard grip.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar just below knee height, hinge forward with a flat back and grip it overhand, hands inside shoulder-width.
Row the bar to your lower stomach, driving your elbows back close to your body.
Lower it until your arms are straight, keeping your torso still.

decisions.name: Smith Rear Delt Row
decisions.reason: Same as everkinetic Smith Machine Rear Deltoid Row.

decisions.name: Smith Reverse-Grip Press
decisions.reason: Flat bench; the closest match is the decline version.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench in a Smith machine and grip the bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart.
Unhook the bar and lower it to your lower chest with your elbows tucked.
Press back up until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Smith Seated Shoulder Press
decisions.reason: Same seated Smith machine overhead press already in the library.

decisions.name: Smith Shoulder Press
decisions.reason: Generic Smith shoulder press; same movement as the library Smith Machine Overhead Shoulder Press.

decisions.name: Smith Shrug
decisions.reason: Same Smith machine shrug as the candidate 'Shoulder Shrugs: Smith Machine'; library only has the behind-the-back version.

decisions.name: Smith Sprint Lunge
decisions.reason: Same Smith machine sprint lunge as the library Lunge Sprint.

decisions.name: Smith Standing Back Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Smith machine version; library only has the barbell behind-the-back wrist curl.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at upper-thigh height, stand with your back to it and grip it behind you, palms facing back, then unhook it.
Let the bar roll down to your fingertips, then curl it back up by flexing your wrists as high as possible.
Keep your arms straight and still so only the wrists move, and lower slowly each rep.

decisions.name: Smith Standing Behind Head Military Press
decisions.reason: Standing Smith version; differs from the seated Smith behind-neck press and the barbell standing behind-neck press.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at neck height, step under it so it sits behind your head, and grip a little wider than your shoulders.
Unhook the bar and press it straight up to lockout, keeping your torso upright and core braced.
Lower under control to about ear level behind your head, stopping where your shoulders stay comfortable.

decisions.name: Smith Standing Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Same standing Smith machine calf raise already in the library.

decisions.name: Smith Standing Military Press
decisions.reason: Standing Smith press; the library Smith Machine Overhead Shoulder Press is performed seated.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at upper-chest height and stand with the bar just in front of your chin, feet hip-width, grip just outside shoulders.
Unhook the bar and press it straight overhead to lockout, keeping ribs down and glutes tight.
Lower under control back to upper-chest level, moving your head slightly back so the bar clears your face.

decisions.name: Spider Crawl Push Up
decisions.reason: Full push-up with a knee-to-elbow drive each rep; the library Spider Crawl holds the bottom position without pressing.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank with hands slightly wider than your shoulders and your body in a straight line.
As you lower into the push-up, bring one knee out to the side toward the same elbow.
Press back up while returning the leg to the plank, then alternate sides each rep.

decisions.name: Standing Single Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Bodyweight standing leg curl has no meaningful resistance (warm-up/rehab drill); the loaded Standing Leg Curl is already in the library.

decisions.name: Standing Wheel Rollerout
decisions.reason: Starts from standing; the library Ab Roller is kneeling and the barbell rollouts use a different apparatus.

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, hinge forward and place the ab wheel on the floor in front of your feet.
Brace your abs and roll the wheel forward until your body is nearly parallel to the floor, without letting your hips sag.
Pull the wheel back toward your feet using your abs and lats, keeping your back from arching.

decisions.name: Stationary Bike Walk
decisions.reason: Easy-pace stationary cycling; same as the library stationary bicycling entry.

decisions.name: Superman Push-Up
decisions.reason: Explosive push-up with a full-body flight phase; a plyometric/circus variant.

decisions.name: Suspended Abdominal Fallout
decisions.reason: Same suspension-strap fallout already in the library.

decisions.name: Triceps Dip (Bench Leg)
decisions.reason: Bench dip with legs extended and feet on the floor; same as the library Bench Dips.

decisions.name: Triceps Dip (Between Benches)
decisions.reason: Feet-on-second-bench dip; same setup and movement as the library Weighted Bench Dip, load optional.

decisions.name: Triceps Dips Floor
decisions.reason: Floor triceps dip; same exercise as the candidate Bench Dip On Floor.

decisions.name: Triceps Press
decisions.reason: Generic name; the bodyweight movement it denotes cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Twin Handle Parallel Grip Lat Pulldown
decisions.reason: Twin-handle parallel-grip pulldown is the library V-Bar Pulldown.

decisions.name: Vertical Leg Raise (On Parallel Bars)
decisions.reason: Straight-leg raise supported on parallel bars/captain's chair; same as the candidate Captain's Chair Straight Leg Raise.

decisions.name: Weighted Front Raise
decisions.reason: Front raise holding a weight plate; same as the library Front Plate Raise.

decisions.name: Weighted Round Arm
decisions.reason: Vague source name; the movement cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Weighted Russian Twist (Legs Up)
decisions.reason: Plate-loaded Russian twist with feet off the floor; same movement as the library Russian Twist.

decisions.name: Weighted Sissy Squat
decisions.reason: Same weighted sissy squat already in the library.

decisions.name: Weighted Standing Curl
decisions.reason: Standing biceps curl with a weight plate; library only has the reverse-grip plate curl. Plate equipment follows the library's Reverse Plate Curls.

instructions_en: Stand tall holding a weight plate by its sides with both hands, arms extended and the plate in front of your thighs.
Curl the plate up toward your chest by bending the elbows, keeping your upper arms fixed at your sides.
Lower slowly to full extension without swinging your torso.

decisions.name: Weighted Standing Hand Squeeze
decisions.reason: Standing plate hand squeeze; same as the library Standing Olympic Plate Hand Squeeze.

decisions.name: Weighted Svend Press
decisions.reason: Plate squeeze press; same as the library Svend Press.

decisions.name: Wheel Rollerout
decisions.reason: Kneeling ab wheel rollout; same as the library Ab Roller.

decisions.name: Wrist Rollerer
decisions.reason: Misspelled wrist roller; same as the library Wrist Roller.

decisions.name: Cable Kickback
decisions.reason: Cable triceps kickback; same as the candidate Cable Tricep Kickback.

decisions.name: Cable Twist (Up-Down)
decisions.reason: High-to-low cable twist is the library Standing Cable Wood Chop.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying External Shoulder Rotation
decisions.reason: Side-lying dumbbell external rotation; same as the library External Rotation.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Upright Shoulder External Rotation
decisions.reason: Upright 90/90 position with the arm abducted; differs from the side-lying External Rotation in the library.

instructions_en: Stand or sit tall with a light dumbbell, upper arm raised out to the side at shoulder height and elbow bent 90 degrees.
Keeping the elbow fixed, rotate the forearm up and back until it points toward the ceiling.
Lower slowly to forearm-horizontal, keeping the shoulder blade set down and back.

decisions.name: Lying Leg-Hip Raise
decisions.reason: Adds a straight-leg hip lift at the top; plain lying leg raise stops at vertical and Bent-Knee Hip Raise uses bent knees.

row.name_en: Lying Leg Raise with Hip Lift
instructions_en: Lie on your back with legs straight and hands flat beside your hips or gripping a bench behind your head.
Raise straight legs to vertical, then curl your hips off the floor, pushing your feet toward the ceiling.
Lower the hips first, then the legs, slowly and without arching your lower back.

decisions.name: Weighted Hanging Leg-Hip Raise
decisions.reason: Loaded version of the same hanging straight-leg hip raise; added weight does not change the movement.

decisions.name: Cable Curl
decisions.reason: Standing two-arm cable curl; same as the library Standing Biceps Cable Curl.

decisions.name: Lever Shoulder Press V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the lever shoulder press already in the library.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Crunch (With Rope Attachment)
decisions.reason: Standing cable crunch with rope; same as the library Standing Rope Crunch.

decisions.name: Burpee
decisions.reason: Standard burpee; same as the candidate Burpees.

decisions.name: Dynamic Chest Stretch (Male)
decisions.reason: Same dynamic chest stretch already in the library; '(Male)' is a source suffix.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Burpee
decisions.reason: Burpee performed holding dumbbells; no loaded burpee exists in the library.

instructions_en: Stand holding a dumbbell in each hand, then squat and place the dumbbells on the floor just outside your feet.
Keeping hold of the dumbbells, step or jump your feet back into a plank, then bring them back toward your hands.
Stand up tall with the dumbbells at your sides and repeat at a steady pace.

decisions.name: Barbell Decline Pullover
decisions.reason: Barbell pullover on a decline bench; same as the library Wide-Grip Decline Barbell Pullover.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Decline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Underhand grip on a decline bench; no barbell reverse-grip decline press exists yet.

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with legs secured and grip the bar underhand, about shoulder-width apart.
With a spotter's help, unrack and lower the bar under control to your lower chest, elbows tucked.
Press back up to lockout, keeping wrists stacked over elbows and a firm grip throughout.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same barbell incline reverse-grip bench press as the candidate Barbell Incline Reverse-Grip Press.

decisions.name: Barbell Wide Reverse Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Reverse-grip bench is normally done at about this width; same as the candidate Reverse Grip Bench Press.

decisions.name: Behind Head Chest Stretch
decisions.reason: Same behind-head chest stretch already in the library.

instructions_en: Set one pulley above shoulder height, take the handle and stand facing away in a staggered stance, hand beside your chest.
Press the handle forward and down until your arm is extended in front of your lower chest.
Return slowly to the start, resisting any rotation through your torso.

decisions.name: Cable Decline Press
decisions.reason: Two-arm high-to-low cable press; the single-arm version is a separate exercise and the library only has flat and incline cable presses.

instructions_en: Set both pulleys above shoulder height, take a handle in each hand and stand facing away in a staggered stance.
Start with hands beside your chest, then press forward and down until your arms extend in front of your lower chest.
Return slowly until your hands are back beside your chest, keeping your core braced.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Decline Chest Fly
decisions.reason: Single-arm high-to-low cable fly; same as the library Single-Arm Cable Crossover.

instructions_en: Set one pulley at its lowest position, take the handle and stand facing away in a staggered stance, hand beside your chest.
Press the handle forward and up until your arm is extended in front of your upper chest.
Return slowly to the start, keeping your torso square and core braced.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Up Straight Crossovers
decisions.reason: Standing upright cable crossover; same as the library Cable Chest Fly.

decisions.name: Cable Upper Chest Crossovers
decisions.reason: Upper-chest cable crossover is the library Low-to-High Cable Fly.

decisions.name: Deep Push Up
decisions.reason: Push-up with hands on dumbbells for extra depth; same as the candidate Deficit Push-Ups.

decisions.name: Drop Push Up
decisions.reason: Drop push-up is a plyometric depth drill.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Fly
decisions.reason: Single-arm version; the library Decline Dumbbell Flyes uses both arms.

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with legs secured, holding one dumbbell above your chest, palm in, and the bench with your free hand.
With a slight bend in the elbow, lower the dumbbell out to the side in a wide arc until you feel a chest stretch.
Bring it back over your chest along the same arc, keeping your torso from rolling.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Fly
decisions.reason: Single-arm version; the library Incline Dumbbell Flyes uses both arms.

instructions_en: Lie on a bench inclined 30 to 45 degrees, holding one dumbbell above your chest, palm in, and brace with your free hand.
Keeping a slight elbow bend, lower the dumbbell out to the side until you feel a stretch across your chest.
Squeeze it back up over your chest along the same arc without letting your torso roll.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press
decisions.reason: Single-arm version; the library Incline Dumbbell Press uses both arms.

instructions_en: Set a bench to 30 to 45 degrees and lie back holding one dumbbell at shoulder level, free hand on your hip or the bench.
Press the dumbbell up over your shoulder until the arm is straight, keeping your torso square.
Lower slowly back to the side of your chest and finish all reps before switching sides.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Bench Fly
decisions.reason: Same single-arm flat bench dumbbell fly already in the library.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Decline Chest Press
decisions.reason: Single-arm decline press; the library has only the two-arm Decline Dumbbell Bench Press.

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with legs secured, holding one dumbbell beside your lower chest and bracing with your free hand.
Press the dumbbell up until the arm is straight over your chest, resisting any twist through your torso.
Lower slowly back to your chest and complete all reps before switching arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Incline Chest Press
decisions.reason: Same single-arm incline dumbbell press as Dumbbell Incline One Arm Press in this batch.

decisions.name: Isometric Chest Squeeze
decisions.reason: Same isometric chest squeeze already in the library.

decisions.name: Machine Inner Chest Press
decisions.reason: Converging lever chest press; no distinct named movement beyond the library Leverage Chest Press.

decisions.name: Smith Wide Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Wide grip; the library has standard and close-grip Smith bench presses only.

instructions_en: Set a flat bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your mid-chest, and grip well outside shoulder width.
Unhook the bar and lower it under control to your mid-chest, elbows angled out but not flared straight sideways.
Press back up to lockout, keeping your shoulder blades pinched and feet planted.

decisions.name: Smith Wide Grip Decline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Wide grip on a decline bench; differs from the flat wide-grip Smith press and the standard-grip Smith decline press.

row.name_en: Smith Machine Wide-Grip Decline Bench Press
instructions_en: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar so it lines up with your lower chest, secure your legs and grip well outside shoulder width.
Unhook the bar and lower it under control to your lower chest.
Press back up to lockout with shoulder blades squeezed together, then re-hook the bar after the last rep.

decisions.name: Wide Hand Push Up
decisions.reason: Wide-hand push-up; same as the library Push-Up Wide.

decisions.name: Lever Unilateral Row
decisions.reason: Lever unilateral row is the library Plate-Loaded Single-Arm Row.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Row
decisions.reason: Chest-supported barbell row with an underhand grip; no such row exists yet.

instructions_en: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees and take a barbell below you with an underhand, shoulder-width grip.
Row the bar toward your lower ribs, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Lower until your arms are straight, keeping your chest on the pad throughout.

decisions.name: Cable Incline Bench Row
decisions.reason: Chest-supported cable row on an incline bench; differs from seated cable rows.

instructions_en: Place an incline bench facing a low pulley and lie face down with your chest on the pad, holding the handle with arms extended.
Row the handle toward your lower chest, squeezing your shoulder blades together.
Return slowly to full arm extension, keeping your chest on the pad.

decisions.name: Cable Palm Rotational Row
decisions.reason: Rotating the handles during the pull is an execution detail of the seated cable row.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Crossover Seated Row
decisions.reason: Unclear crossed-rope seated row; cannot be identified as a distinct exercise and at best adds noise to the seated cable row.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Elevated Seated Row
decisions.reason: Elevated seated cable row; the rope attachment does not change the library Elevated Cable Rows.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Extension Incline Bench Row
decisions.reason: Unclear row-plus-extension combination; not a recognisable, programmable exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Seated Row
decisions.reason: Seated cable row with a rope; attachment does not change the library Seated Cable Row.

decisions.name: Cable Upper Row
decisions.reason: Vague source name; the row variant cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Cable Wide Grip Rear Pulldown Behind Neck
decisions.reason: Same wide-grip behind-the-neck pulldown already in the library.

decisions.name: Close Grip Chin-Up
decisions.reason: Close-grip underhand pull-up; same as the candidate Biceps Narrow Pull-Ups.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Rear Delt Row
decisions.reason: Lying chest-supported version; the rear delt row candidates are bent-over.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a flat or slightly inclined bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight, palms facing your feet.
Row the dumbbells up and out with elbows flared wide, until your upper arms are in line with your shoulders.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly to straight arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Palm Rotational Bent Over Row
decisions.reason: Rotating the palms during the pull is an execution detail of the bent-over two-dumbbell row.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench One Arm Row

row.name_en: Dumbbell Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Incline Bench Row
instructions_en: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees, holding one dumbbell with an underhand grip, arm straight.
Row the dumbbell toward your hip, keeping the elbow close to your side and your chest on the pad.
Lower slowly to full extension and finish all reps before switching arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Incline Bench Two Arm Row
decisions.reason: Underhand grip; the library Chest-Supported Dumbbell Row uses a neutral grip.

instructions_en: Lie face down on an incline bench set to about 30 degrees with a dumbbell in each hand, using an underhand grip.
Row both dumbbells toward your hips, keeping your elbows close to your sides and chest on the pad.
Squeeze your back at the top, then lower slowly to full arm extension.

decisions.name: Ez Bar Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
decisions.reason: EZ-bar is barbell equipment; same underhand bent-over row as the library Reverse Grip Bent-Over Rows.

instructions_en: Kneel facing a bench and place your forearms or hands on it, shoulder-width apart.
Sit your hips back toward your heels and let your chest sink toward the floor until you feel a stretch along your sides.
Hold the position while breathing slowly, without bouncing.

decisions.name: Lever One Arm Lateral Wide Pulldown

instructions_en: Sit at the plate-loaded pulldown machine with thighs under the pad and grab one handle with your arm fully extended.
Pull the handle down toward your shoulder, driving the elbow down and slightly back.
Let the handle rise slowly until the arm is straight, and complete all reps before switching sides.
Sit at the row machine with your chest against the pad and take the handles with an underhand grip, arms extended.
Row the handles toward your lower ribs, keeping elbows close to your body and pulling your shoulder blades back.
Return slowly to full arm extension without letting your chest leave the pad.

decisions.name: Lever Reverse T-Bar Row
decisions.reason: Same underhand lever T-bar row as Lever T-Bar Reverse Grip Row in this batch.

decisions.name: Lever T-Bar Reverse Grip Row
decisions.reason: Underhand grip; the library Lying T-Bar Row uses an overhand or neutral grip.

instructions_en: Stand on the T-bar row machine platform, lean your chest onto the pad and take the handles with an underhand grip.
Row the handles toward your chest, driving your elbows back close to your sides.
Lower under control until your arms are straight, keeping your chest on the pad.

decisions.name: Lever One Arm Lateral High Row

instructions_en: Sit facing the high row machine with thighs under the pad and grab one handle up in front of you, arm extended.
Pull the handle down and back toward your side, driving the elbow down past your ribs.
Return slowly until the arm is straight, then complete all reps before switching sides.

decisions.name: Smith One Arm Row
decisions.reason: Single-arm Smith row; the closest match is an upright row, and the library Smith Bent Over Row uses both arms.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at knee height, stand side-on to it and hinge forward, bracing your free hand on your thigh or a bench.
Grip the bar near its center with one hand, unhook it and row it toward your hip, elbow close to your side.
Lower until the arm is straight, keeping your back flat, and switch sides after the set.

decisions.name: Smith Reverse Grip Bent Over Row
