instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at knee height, take an underhand shoulder-width grip and unhook it.
Hinge at the hips until your torso is about 45 degrees or lower, with a flat back and soft knees.
Row the bar to your lower stomach with elbows tight to your sides, then lower slowly to straight arms.

decisions.name: Spine Stretch
decisions.reason: Same spine stretch as the library Spinal Stretch.

instructions_en: Lie face down with hands under your shoulders and the tops of your feet on the floor.
Straighten your arms to lift your chest, hips and thighs off the floor, pressing through your hands and feet.
Draw your shoulders down away from your ears, look forward and hold while breathing steadily.

decisions.name: Barbell Floor Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Standing barbell calf raise from the floor; same as the library Standing Barbell Calf Raise.

instructions_en: Attach a bar to a low pulley and stand facing the stack with the balls of your feet on a step or plate.
Hold the bar at arm's length, let your heels drop for a full stretch, then rise onto your toes as high as possible.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly, keeping your knees straight but not locked.

decisions.name: Cable Standing One Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Kept as the one single-leg cable calf raise row (Liftosaur's Cable Single Leg Calf Raise points here); the library has the two-leg cable calf raise only.

instructions_en: Attach an ankle strap or belt to a low pulley, stand on one foot with the ball of the foot on a step and hold a support.
Keep the knee straight and lower your heel for a full stretch.
Rise as high as you can onto your toes, pause, and lower slowly; switch legs after the set.

decisions.name: Calf Stretch With Rope
decisions.reason: Seated calf stretch using a rope as a pulling aid; same stretch as the library Seated Calf Stretch.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Hammer Grip
decisions.reason: Hand grip on the dumbbell does not change the library Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated One Leg Calf Raise - Palm Up
decisions.reason: Hand grip on the dumbbell does not change the library Dumbbell Seated One-Leg Calf Raise.

decisions.name: Hack Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Calf raise in the hack squat machine; same as the candidate Calf Raise using Hack Squat Machine.

decisions.name: Hack One Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Single-leg version; the two-leg hack squat machine calf raise is a separate exercise.

row.name_en: Hack Squat Machine Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions_en: Set up in the hack squat machine with shoulders under the pads and the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the platform.
Lift the other foot away, release the safeties and lower your heel for a deep calf stretch.
Press up onto your toes as high as possible, pause, and lower slowly; switch legs after the set.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Squat Calf Raise On Leg Press Machine
decisions.reason: Calf press on a leg press machine; same as the library Calf Press On The Leg Press Machine.

decisions.name: One Leg Donkey Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Bent-over donkey position on one leg; differs from the upright single-leg calf raise (wger-702).

instructions_en: Stand with the ball of one foot on a step, hinge forward at the hips and rest your hands on a bench or rail.
Rise as high as you can onto the ball of the foot, keeping the knee almost straight.
Lower the heel slowly below the step for a full stretch, then repeat before switching legs.

decisions.name: One Leg Floor Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Same bodyweight single-leg standing calf raise; floor vs step is not a material difference.

decisions.name: Seated Calf Stretch (Male)
decisions.reason: Same seated calf stretch; the (Male) tag is a source suffix.

decisions.name: Sled Calf Press On Leg Press
decisions.reason: Same calf press on the leg press machine.

decisions.name: Sled One Leg Calf Press On Leg Press
decisions.reason: One leg at a time, unlike the two-leg calf press on the leg press (edb-1391).

row.name_en: Single-Leg Calf Press on Leg Press
instructions_en: Sit in the leg press and place the ball of one foot on the lower edge of the platform, heel hanging off.
Straighten the knee, release the safeties and press the platform away by pointing your toes.
Let the heel travel back slowly for a deep stretch, keeping the knee fixed and slightly soft.

decisions.name: Smith One Leg Floor Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Single-leg version; the library has only the two-leg Smith Machine Calf Raise.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar across your upper back and stand on one foot, on the floor or on a plate.
Unrack the bar and rise onto the ball of the working foot as high as possible.
Lower the heel under control, finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Smith Seated One Leg Calf Raise
decisions.reason: Seated, single-leg Smith variant; no seated Smith calf raise in the library.

row.name_en: Smith Machine Seated Single-Leg Calf Raise
instructions_en: Sit on a bench under a Smith bar with the ball of one foot on a plate and the padded bar resting across that knee.
Unrack the bar and raise the heel as high as possible by pushing through the ball of the foot.
Lower the heel slowly for a full stretch, then repeat before switching legs.

decisions.name: Smith Toe Raise
decisions.reason: Toe raise here is a standing calf raise on the Smith machine, already in the library.

decisions.name: Standing Calves
decisions.reason: Same bodyweight two-leg standing calf raise (wger-622 is the machine version).

decisions.name: Bench Dip On Floor
decisions.reason: Same floor triceps dip.

decisions.name: Muscle-Up (On Vertical Bar)
decisions.reason: Done on a straight bar; the library muscle-ups are ring versions.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with an overhand grip slightly wider than shoulder width.
Pull explosively toward your lower chest, then drive your chest over the bar by leaning forward.
Press to straight arms above the bar, then lower back to a hang with control.

decisions.name: Back Pec Stretch
decisions.reason: Vague name; source data mixes lats and chest and describes contradictory arm positions, so the stretch cannot be identified.

decisions.name: Calf Push Stretch With Hands Against Wall
decisions.reason: Same wall calf stretch with hands on the wall.

decisions.name: Barbell Lateral Lunge
decisions.reason: Steps out and back each rep; differs from the slider version (wger-1604) and the static Barbell Side Split Squat.

instructions_en: Stand tall with a barbell racked across your upper back and feet together.
Take a wide step to one side and sit your hips back over that foot, keeping the other leg straight.
Push off the bent leg to return to the start, then alternate sides.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse One Arm Curl
decisions.reason: One arm with a handle; the library Reverse Cable Curl uses both hands on a bar.

instructions_en: Stand facing a low pulley holding a single handle with an overhand, palm-down grip.
Keep the elbow pinned to your side and curl the handle up toward your shoulder.
Lower slowly to full extension without letting the wrist bend.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Overhand (reverse) grip; the library one-arm preacher curl is underhand.

instructions_en: Sit at a preacher bench with one upper arm on the pad, holding a dumbbell with an overhand grip.
Curl the dumbbell up toward your shoulder, keeping the wrist straight and the arm flat on the pad.
Lower slowly until the elbow is almost straight, then repeat before switching arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Neutral Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same single-arm neutral-grip wrist curl; forearm resting on the thigh vs the bench is not a material difference.

decisions.name: Hug Keens To Chest
decisions.reason: Same knees-to-chest stretch (name typo in source).

decisions.name: Iron Cross Stretch
decisions.reason: Same iron cross mobility stretch already in the library.

decisions.name: Modified Push Up To Lower Arms
decisions.reason: Unclear 'modified' variant of the forearm-to-hands push-up; the identifiable movement is wger-1406 (Plank-to-Elbow Extension).

decisions.name: Reverse Hyper On Flat Bench
decisions.reason: Done on a flat bench with bodyweight; the library Reverse Hyperextension uses the dedicated machine.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a high flat bench with your hips at the edge, legs hanging down, and hold the bench.
Squeeze your glutes and raise both straight legs until they line up with your torso.
Lower them under control without swinging or over-arching your lower back.

decisions.name: Seated Glute Stretch
decisions.reason: Same seated figure-four glute stretch.

decisions.name: Sled 45 Degrees One Leg Press
decisions.reason: One leg at a time; the library has only two-leg leg presses.

instructions_en: Sit in the leg press and place one foot in the middle of the platform, resting the other foot on the frame.
Release the safeties and lower the platform until the knee is bent about 90 degrees.
Press back up through the whole foot without locking the knee, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Smith Seated Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Smith machine apparatus; library wrist curls use a barbell, dumbbell or cable.

instructions_en: Sit on a bench facing a low Smith bar, unhook it with an underhand grip and rest your forearms on your thighs.
Let your wrists extend past your knees, then curl the bar up by flexing the wrists.
Lower slowly to the start, keeping your forearms fixed on your thighs.

decisions.name: Straight Leg Outer Hip Abductor
decisions.reason: Same straight-leg bodyweight hip abduction.

decisions.name: Chest Dip (On Dip-Pull-Up Cage)
decisions.reason: Same bodyweight chest dip; the cage is only where the dip bars are.

decisions.name: Assisted Standing Chin-Up
decisions.reason: Same machine-assisted chin-up; standing vs kneeling on the platform is not material.

decisions.name: Assisted Standing Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Same assisted pull-up, covered by the library Pull-Up / Assisted Pull-Up (also edb-0017).

decisions.name: Smith Front Squat (Clean Grip)
decisions.reason: Front-rack squat on the Smith machine; the library front squats are barbell only.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at upper-chest height and rest it on your front shoulders with elbows high, feet shoulder-width apart.
Unrack and squat down, keeping your torso upright and knees tracking over your toes.
Drive back up through the whole foot to standing.

decisions.name: Smith Low Bar Squat
decisions.reason: Bar placement on a guided Smith bar does not make a separate exercise; same as Smith Machine Squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Low Bar Squat
decisions.reason: Known low-bar variant with a different bar position and torso angle from the standard back squat.

instructions_en: Place the bar low on your upper back, just below the top of the shoulder blades, with a firm grip.
Brace, push your hips back and bend your knees, letting the torso lean forward to keep the bar over midfoot.
Squat to at least parallel, then drive your hips up to stand.

decisions.name: Barbell High Bar Squat
decisions.reason: High-bar is the standard Barbell Back Squat (also covered by Olympic Squat).

decisions.name: Dumbbell Finger Curls
decisions.reason: Finger flexion for grip, not an elbow curl; the library Finger Curls use a barbell.

instructions_en: Sit with your forearm resting on your thigh, palm up, holding a dumbbell at the base of your fingers.
Open your fingers and let the dumbbell roll toward your fingertips without dropping it.
Close your fingers to roll it back into your palm, then repeat.

decisions.name: Lever Gripless Shrug V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of Lever Gripless Shrug.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Over Bench One Arm Reverse Wrist Curl
decisions.reason: Same single-arm palms-down wrist curl; forearm on the bench vs thigh is not material.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Dip
decisions.reason: Same seated dip machine.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Crunch
decisions.reason: Same seated ab crunch machine.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Close Grip Military Press
decisions.reason: Close grip shifts more work to the triceps; library overhead presses use a standard grip.

instructions_en: Stand with the bar on your front shoulders, hands just inside shoulder width and elbows slightly in front of the bar.
Brace your core and press the bar straight overhead until your arms lock out.
Lower it to your upper chest under control, moving your head back out of the bar's path.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Wide Military Press
decisions.reason: Wide grip variant; library overhead presses use a standard grip.

instructions_en: Stand with the bar on your front shoulders, hands well outside shoulder width.
Brace your core and glutes and press the bar overhead to full lockout.
Lower it under control to your upper chest without arching your lower back.

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Seated Curls
decisions.reason: Seated position; the library EZ-Bar Curl is standing.

instructions_en: Sit on the end of a bench, feet flat, holding an EZ-bar with an underhand grip just above your thighs.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar toward your shoulders.
Lower until your arms are nearly straight, without leaning back.

decisions.name: Barbell Full Squat (Back Pov)
decisions.reason: Camera-angle variant (back view) of the same full squat.

decisions.name: Barbell Full Squat (Side Pov)
decisions.reason: Camera-angle variant (side view) of the same full squat.

decisions.name: Sled 45° Leg Press (Side Pov)
decisions.reason: Camera-angle variant (side view) of the standard 45-degree leg press.

decisions.name: Sled 45в° Leg Press (Back Pov)
decisions.reason: Camera-angle variant (back view) of the standard 45-degree leg press.

decisions.name: Twist Hip Lift
decisions.reason: Not a recognisable standard exercise; a bridge with a lower-body twist that nobody programs as its own lift.

decisions.name: Push-Up On Lower Arms
decisions.reason: Same forearm plank to straight-arm elbow-extension push-up (sphinx push-up).

decisions.name: Crab Twist Toe Touch
decisions.reason: No crab-position toe touch in the library.

instructions_en: Sit with knees bent and hands on the floor behind you, then lift your hips into a crab position.
Kick one leg up and reach the opposite hand to touch that foot.
Return hand and foot to the floor and alternate sides without dropping your hips.

decisions.name: One Leg Squat
decisions.reason: Bodyweight one-leg squat with the free leg forward is the pistol squat.

decisions.name: Lever Incline Chest Press V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the leverage incline chest press.

decisions.name: Standing Calf Raise (On A Staircase)
decisions.reason: Same bodyweight two-leg calf raise; doing it on a stair is not material.

decisions.name: Butterfly Yoga Pose
decisions.reason: Same seated butterfly stretch, named as a yoga pose.

decisions.name: Oblique Crunch V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the lying oblique crunch.

decisions.name: All Fours Squad Stretch
decisions.reason: Same all-fours quad stretch (name typo in source).

decisions.name: Barbell Full Zercher Squat
decisions.reason: Same Zercher squat.

decisions.name: Reclining Big Toe Pose With Rope
decisions.reason: Same lying hamstring stretch with a strap around the foot (yoga name).

decisions.name: Runners Stretch
decisions.reason: Same runner's stretch.

decisions.name: Seated Wide Angle Pose Sequence
decisions.reason: Yoga pose sequence; the static seated straddle stretch is already in the library (The Straddle).

decisions.name: Standing Hamstring And Calf Stretch With Strap
decisions.reason: Same standing hamstring and calf stretch, which already uses a belt or strap.

decisions.name: World Greatest Stretch
decisions.reason: Same World's Greatest Stretch.

decisions.name: Lever Preacher Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the machine preacher curl.

decisions.name: Lever Hammer Grip Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Neutral grip on the preacher machine; library Machine Preacher Curls are underhand.

instructions_en: Set the seat so your upper arms lie flat on the pad, and grip the handles with palms facing each other.
Curl the handles toward your shoulders without lifting your elbows off the pad.
Lower slowly until your arms are nearly straight.

decisions.name: Lever Reverse Grip Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Overhand grip on the preacher machine; library Machine Preacher Curls are underhand.

instructions_en: Adjust the seat so your upper arms rest flat on the pad, and grip the handles palms down.
Curl the handles up while keeping your wrists straight and elbows on the pad.
Lower under control to near full extension.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Decline One Arm Hammer Press
decisions.reason: One arm at a time; the decline hammer press (edb-0303) uses two dumbbells.

instructions_en: Lie on a decline bench with feet secured, holding one dumbbell at chest level with the palm facing in.
Press the dumbbell up over your lower chest, keeping your torso square and the free hand on the bench.
Lower it slowly to the side of your chest with the elbow close to your body.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline One Arm Hammer Press
decisions.reason: One arm at a time; the incline hammer press (edb-0321) uses two dumbbells.

instructions_en: Lie on an incline bench holding one dumbbell at shoulder level with the palm facing in.
Press it up over your upper chest, bracing your core so your torso does not rotate.
Lower slowly to the side of your chest and repeat before switching arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Grip Press
decisions.reason: Ambiguous: name and source do not establish whether it is a bench or overhead press; too obscure to identify with confidence.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Palms In Incline Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same neutral-grip incline dumbbell press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same reverse (underhand) grip dumbbell bench press.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Decline Close Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Decline bench angle; the library Smith close-grip press is flat.

row.name_en: Smith Machine Decline Close-Grip Bench Press
instructions_en: Set a decline bench under the Smith bar, secure your legs and grip the bar just inside shoulder width.
Unrack and lower the bar to your lower chest, keeping your elbows tucked close to your sides.
Press back up to full lockout, then rerack by rotating the bar.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Reverse Decline Close Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Gimmicky stack of modifiers with 'reverse' undefined; the source describes the plain decline close-grip press (edb-1625).

decisions.name: Ez Barbell Close Grip Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: The library Preacher Curl already uses the EZ-bar's close inner grip.

decisions.name: Cable Close Grip Curl
decisions.reason: Standing with a close grip; edb-0182 is done lying down.

instructions_en: Attach a straight bar to a low pulley and grip it underhand with your hands a few inches apart.
Keep your elbows at your sides and curl the bar toward your chest.
Lower slowly to full extension while keeping your torso still.

decisions.name: Cable Drag Curl
decisions.reason: Drag path with elbows travelling back, unlike a standard cable curl; library Drag Curl is barbell.

instructions_en: Stand close to a low pulley holding a straight bar underhand at shoulder width.
Curl by driving your elbows back, dragging the bar up along your torso toward your lower chest.
Lower the bar along the same path until your arms are straight.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: One arm with a handle; the library Cable Preacher Curl uses both hands on a bar.

instructions_en: Place a preacher bench in front of a low pulley, take a single handle and rest that upper arm on the pad.
Curl the handle toward your shoulder, keeping the back of the arm on the pad.
Lower slowly to near full extension and repeat before switching arms.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Reverse Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: One arm at a time; the cable reverse preacher curl (edb-0209) is two-handed.

instructions_en: Set a preacher bench before a low pulley and hold a single handle palm down, upper arm flat on the pad.
Curl the handle up with a straight wrist, keeping the elbow planted.
Lower under control to near full extension, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Cable Pulldown Bicep Curl
decisions.reason: Unclear movement: the name suggests a pulldown and curl hybrid while the source describes pulling a bar down to the thighs.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Hammer Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Done over a preacher pad; the rope hammer curls in the index (ek-0216, library) are standing.

instructions_en: Attach a rope to a low pulley, set a preacher bench in front and rest both upper arms on the pad.
Hold the rope ends with palms facing each other and curl them toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly without lifting your elbows from the pad.

decisions.name: Cable Rope One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: One arm at a time; edb-1639 is the two-handed rope version.

instructions_en: Rest one upper arm on a preacher pad facing a low pulley, holding a rope end or handle with a neutral grip.
Curl toward your shoulder with the thumb up, keeping the elbow planted.
Lower under control to near full extension, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Curl
decisions.reason: Seated position; the cable curls in the index are standing.

instructions_en: Sit facing a low pulley with a straight bar attached, knees slightly bent and torso upright.
Grip the bar underhand and curl it toward your chest, keeping your elbows at your sides.
Lower slowly to straight arms without leaning back.

decisions.name: Cable Seated One Arm Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Same cable concentration curl, which is always seated and one-armed.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Overhead Curl
decisions.reason: Seated at a single high pulley; the library Overhead Cable Curl is standing between two pulleys.

instructions_en: Sit facing a high pulley, such as a lat pulldown station, and grip the bar underhand with arms raised forward.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows slowly back to the start.

decisions.name: Cable Squatting Curl
decisions.reason: Gimmicky squat-and-curl hybrid; not a standard gym exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Two Arm Curl On Incline Bench
decisions.reason: No incline-bench cable curl in the library.

instructions_en: Set an incline bench between two low pulleys, sit back and take a handle in each hand with arms hanging down.
Keep your upper arms still and curl the handles toward your shoulders.
Lower slowly to full extension for a deep biceps stretch.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Alternate Hammer Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Same two-dumbbell hammer preacher curl; alternating arms is not a material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Alternate Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Same two-dumbbell preacher curl; alternating arms is not a material difference.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Alternate Seated Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Seated position; the library Alternate Hammer Curl is standing.

instructions_en: Sit upright on a bench with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides, palms facing in.
Curl one dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the thumb up and the elbow still.
Lower it slowly, then curl the other arm.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl Lunge With Bowling Motion
decisions.reason: Gimmicky combination (curl, lunge and bowling rotation) that nobody programs in a gym.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Cross Body Hammer Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: 'V. 2' source variant of the cross-body hammer curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lunge With Bicep Curl
decisions.reason: Same forward lunge with dumbbell biceps curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Wide Curl
decisions.reason: Same lying supine dumbbell curl; a wide arm angle is a cue, not a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Hammer Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Neutral grip; the library One Arm Dumbbell Preacher Curl is underhand and Preacher Hammer Dumbbell Curl is two-armed.

instructions_en: Rest one upper arm on a preacher pad, holding a dumbbell with the palm facing in.
Curl the dumbbell up with the thumb leading, keeping the elbow on the pad.
Lower slowly to near full extension, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell High Curl
decisions.reason: Source describes a standard standing dumbbell curl; same as Dumbbell Biceps Curl.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Prone Curl
decisions.reason: Flat-bench prone curl with one arm; the library prone curl is on an incline with two dumbbells.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a high flat bench and let one arm hang straight down, holding a dumbbell with the palm forward.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm vertical.
Lower under control to a full hang, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Prone Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Neutral grip, unlike the underhand single-arm prone curl (edb-1665).

instructions_en: Lie face down on a high flat bench with one arm hanging straight down, holding a dumbbell palm in.
Curl the dumbbell up with the thumb leading, keeping the upper arm still.
Lower slowly to a full hang and repeat before switching arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Reverse Spider Curl
decisions.reason: Overhand grip, one arm; the library spider curl is an underhand EZ-bar lift.

instructions_en: Lie chest down on an incline bench with one arm hanging straight down, holding a dumbbell palm down.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulder, keeping the upper arm vertical and the wrist straight.
Lower slowly to a full hang, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Seated Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Seated and one arm at a time; no such hammer curl in the library.

instructions_en: Sit upright on a bench holding one dumbbell at your side with the palm facing in.
Curl it toward your shoulder with the thumb up, keeping the elbow close to your side.
Lower slowly to full extension, finish the set, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Standing Curl
decisions.reason: Free-standing curl with the upper arm unsupported, unlike the standing concentration curl (edb-0421).

instructions_en: Stand tall holding a dumbbell in one hand at your side, palm facing forward.
Curl it toward your shoulder without letting the elbow drift forward or your torso sway.
Lower slowly to full extension, complete the set, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Standing Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Neutral grip, unlike the underhand single-arm curl (edb-1670); library hammer curls use both arms.

instructions_en: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side with the palm facing your thigh.
Curl it toward your shoulder, keeping the thumb up and the upper arm still.
Lower under control, complete the set, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Zottman Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Zottman rotation on one arm; library has the underhand one-arm preacher curl and a two-arm Zottman preacher curl.

instructions_en: Rest one upper arm on a preacher pad, holding a dumbbell with an underhand grip.
Curl it up, then at the top rotate your palm to face down.
Lower slowly with the palm down, rotate back to underhand at the bottom and repeat.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Prone Incline Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Neutral grip; the library Dumbbell Prone Incline Curl is underhand.

instructions_en: Lie chest down on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight and palms facing in.
Curl both dumbbells up with thumbs leading, keeping your upper arms vertical.
Lower slowly to a full hang.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Spider Curl
decisions.reason: Two dumbbells at once, unlike the single-arm version (edb-1667).

instructions_en: Lie chest down on an incline bench with arms hanging straight, holding a dumbbell in each hand palms down.
Curl the dumbbells up while keeping your upper arms vertical and wrists straight.
Lower under control to a full hang.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Hammer Curl
decisions.reason: Seated with both arms together; library hammer curls are standing and edb-1648 alternates arms.

instructions_en: Sit on the end of a bench, back tall, holding a dumbbell in each hand with palms facing your thighs.
Keeping elbows pinned at your sides and palms facing in, curl both dumbbells toward your shoulders.
Lower them slowly to full arm extension without swinging your torso.

decisions.name: Ez Bar Seated Close Grip Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Same seated close-grip concentration curl; the library row already covers a barbell or EZ-bar.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Bicep Curl
decisions.reason: Fixed-track Smith bar, not the selectorized Machine Bicep Curl.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar at mid-thigh height, stand close, and grip it underhand at shoulder width.
Unhook the bar and curl it toward your chest, keeping your elbows by your sides.
Lower under control to full extension, then rotate the hooks to rack the bar after the set.

decisions.name: Squat To Overhead Reach
decisions.reason: Bodyweight warm-up/mobility drill (squat with an overhead reach), not a training exercise.

decisions.name: Squat To Overhead Reach With Twist
decisions.reason: Warm-up drill: bodyweight squat with overhead reach and torso twist.

decisions.name: Posterior Step To Overhead Reach
decisions.reason: Warm-up drill: unloaded reverse lunge with an overhead reach.

decisions.name: Lunge With Twist
decisions.reason: Bodyweight dynamic warm-up (lunge with torso rotation), not a loaded training exercise.

decisions.name: Push And Pull Bodyweight
decisions.reason: Vague name; the source describes only push-up steps, so no distinct exercise can be identified.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Push Press
decisions.reason: Dumbbell version; the library push presses are barbell only.

instructions_en: Stand with feet hip-width apart, holding dumbbells at shoulder height.
Dip briefly at the knees, then drive up hard through your legs and press the dumbbells overhead to lockout.
Lower the dumbbells back to your shoulders with control, absorbing the weight with a slight knee bend.

decisions.name: Assisted Lying Calves Stretch
decisions.reason: Partner-assisted stretch; no partner calf stretch in the library.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with legs straight while your partner lifts one straight leg, holding the heel and the ball of the foot.
Your partner gently presses your toes toward your shin until you feel a stretch in the calf.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch legs; tell your partner to ease off if anything feels sharp.

decisions.name: Assisted Lying Glutes Stretch
decisions.reason: Partner-assisted knee-to-chest glute stretch; no partner version in the library.

instructions_en: Lie on your back and bend one knee toward your chest while the other leg stays straight on the floor.
Your partner places a hand on the bent knee and gently presses it toward the same-side shoulder.
Hold the stretch in your glute, keeping the straight leg down, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Assisted Lying Gluteus And Piriformis Stretch
decisions.reason: Knee is taken across the body for the piriformis, unlike the straight knee-to-chest glute stretch.

row.name_en: Partner-Assisted Lying Glute and Piriformis Stretch
instructions_en: Lie on your back and bend one knee while your partner holds that knee and ankle.
Your partner guides the knee across your body toward the opposite shoulder until you feel a deep stretch in the hip.
Keep your hips flat on the floor, hold, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Assisted Side Lying Adductor Stretch
decisions.reason: Partner-assisted; the library side-lying groin stretch is done alone.

instructions_en: Lie on your side with legs straight and your head resting on your bottom arm; your partner kneels behind you.
Your partner lifts your top leg straight up and out to the side until you feel a stretch along the inner thigh.
Keep your hips stacked and toes pointing forward; hold, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Assisted Prone Lying Quads Stretch
decisions.reason: Partner-assisted; library quad stretches are self-performed.

instructions_en: Lie face down with legs straight while your partner kneels beside you and holds one ankle.
Your partner slowly bends your knee, bringing the heel toward your glutes until the front of the thigh stretches.
Keep your hips pressed into the floor; hold, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Assisted Prone Rectus Femoris Stretch
decisions.reason: Adds hip extension to the prone quad stretch to target the rectus femoris and hip flexors.

instructions_en: Lie face down while your partner bends one knee, bringing your heel toward your glutes.
With a hand under your thigh, your partner lifts the knee slightly off the floor to extend the hip.
Keep your hips down and stop at a firm stretch across the front of the hip and thigh; switch legs.
Attach a rope to a cable at waist height, hold the ends with arms extended, and step back to create tension.
Squat down until your thighs are near parallel, keeping your chest up and arms straight.
Stand up and row the rope to your lower ribs as you rise, squeezing your shoulder blades, then reverse slowly.

decisions.name: Barbell Seated Close Grip Behind Neck Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Same seated overhead barbell triceps extension (close grip, bar lowered behind the head); no library twin.

decisions.name: Barbell Lying Back Of The Head Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Same lying barbell triceps extension with the bar lowered behind the head.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Grip Skullcrusher
decisions.reason: Same underhand-grip skull crusher as everkinetic's Old School Reverse Extensions (kept, with its CC BY-SA images).

decisions.name: Cable High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Overhead cable triceps extension; pulley height and attachment do not make a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Tricep Pushdown
decisions.reason: Single arm with an overhand grip; library pushdowns are two-arm and its one-arm cable extension uses an underhand grip.

instructions_en: Attach a single handle to a high pulley and grip it overhand with one hand, elbow tucked at your side.
Press the handle down until your arm is fully straight, keeping the upper arm still.
Let the handle rise slowly until your forearm passes parallel, then finish the set and switch arms.

decisions.name: Cable Rope High Pulley Overhead Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Rope overhead cable triceps extension, already in the library.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Incline Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Incline-bench cable triceps extension; rope instead of bar is not a distinct exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Rope Lying On Floor Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Lying rope triceps extension with the head toward a low pulley; floor instead of bench changes nothing.

decisions.name: Cable Standing Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Underhand grip; the library single-arm low-pulley overhead extension uses the standard grip.

row.name_en: Cable Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Overhead Triceps Extension
instructions_en: Face away from a low pulley holding a single handle overhead with an underhand grip, palm facing back.
Keeping the upper arm beside your head, bend the elbow to lower the handle behind your head.
Extend the elbow to straighten the arm overhead, then finish the set and switch arms.

decisions.name: Cable Two Arm Tricep Kickback
decisions.reason: Both arms at once on two pulleys; the cable kickback candidates (wger-1509, edb-0860) are single-arm.

instructions_en: Set both pulleys low, take a handle in each hand with the cables crossed, and hinge forward with a flat back.
Pin your upper arms beside your torso with elbows bent about 90 degrees.
Extend both elbows to straighten your arms behind you, pause, then return slowly.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Alternate Extension
decisions.reason: Lying two-dumbbell triceps extension done one arm at a time; alternating does not make it a new exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Alternate Kickback
decisions.reason: Seated bent-over dumbbell kickback done alternating arms; same exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Forward Lunge Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Gimmicky combo of a forward lunge and an overhead triceps extension; the light arm load leaves the lunge pointless.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Two Arm Extension
decisions.reason: Same incline-bench triceps extension with two dumbbells, neutral grip, lowered behind the head.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Single Extension
decisions.reason: Single-arm with a neutral grip; library single-arm lying extensions are the pronated and supinated variants.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench and hold one dumbbell straight above your shoulder, palm facing in.
Keeping the upper arm vertical, bend the elbow and lower the dumbbell beside your head.
Extend the elbow to return, steadying the working arm with your free hand if needed; switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Over Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Seated bent-over two-dumbbell triceps extension (kickback); same exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Reverse Grip One Arm Overhead Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Underhand grip; library single-arm overhead dumbbell extensions use the standard palm-forward grip.

row.name_en: Dumbbell Seated Single-Arm Reverse-Grip Triceps Extension
instructions_en: Sit tall on a bench with back support, holding one dumbbell overhead with an underhand grip, palm facing back.
Keeping the upper arm beside your ear, bend the elbow to lower the dumbbell behind your head.
Straighten the arm to return overhead, then complete the set and switch arms.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternating Tricep Kickback
decisions.reason: Standing bent-over two-dumbbell kickback done alternating arms; same exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Tricep Kickback With Stork Stance
decisions.reason: Single-leg (stork) stance only adds a balance gimmick to the standard dumbbell kickback.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Twisting Bench Press
decisions.reason: Grip rotates from pronated to neutral each rep; the library dumbbell bench presses keep one grip.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench pressing two dumbbells above your chest, palms facing your feet.
As you lower the dumbbells, rotate your wrists so your palms face each other at the bottom, elbows close to your sides.
Press back up, turning the palms toward your feet again as you reach lockout.

decisions.name: Ez Bar Lying Close Grip Triceps Extension Behind Head
decisions.reason: Same lying close-grip extension behind the head; the library row covers a barbell or EZ-bar.

decisions.name: Ez Bar Standing French Press
decisions.reason: French press is the standing overhead triceps extension; the library row covers a barbell or EZ-bar.

decisions.name: Smith Machine Incline Tricep Extension
decisions.reason: Smith machine track instead of the free barbell used in the library incline triceps extension.

instructions_en: Set an incline bench under a Smith machine and hold the bar at arm's length above your upper chest, overhand grip.
Keeping your upper arms still, bend your elbows to lower the bar toward your forehead.
Extend your elbows to drive the bar back up, and rotate the hooks to rack it after the set.

decisions.name: Three Bench Dip
decisions.reason: Bench dip with the feet raised on a third bench; same movement.

decisions.name: Weighted Tricep Dips
decisions.reason: Bench dip with added load on the lap; same as Weighted Bench Dip.

decisions.name: Barbell Single Leg Deadlift
decisions.reason: Single-leg barbell hinge; the library has two-leg barbell deadlifts and the dumbbell single-leg RDL.

instructions_en: Hold a barbell in front of your thighs with an overhand grip and shift your weight onto one leg.
Hinge at the hip, letting the free leg extend behind you as the bar slides down the standing leg.
Stop at a hamstring stretch with a flat back, then drive the hip forward to stand; switch legs.

decisions.name: Assisted Sit-Up
decisions.reason: Sit-up with the feet held or anchored; same as the library Sit-Up.

decisions.name: Single Leg Squat (Pistol) Male
decisions.reason: Bodyweight pistol squat; the 'Male' suffix is a source artifact.

decisions.name: Hanging Oblique Knee Raise
decisions.reason: Knees travel up and across to each side for the obliques; the library hanging knee raise goes straight up.

instructions_en: Hang from a pull-up bar with straight arms and your legs together.
Raise your knees up and across toward one shoulder, curling and rotating the pelvis.
Lower with control to a still hang, then repeat to the other side.

decisions.name: Shoulder Grip Pull-Up
decisions.reason: A shoulder-width overhand pull-up is the standard pull-up.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Upright Row (Back Pov)
decisions.reason: Camera-angle (back POV) copy of the dumbbell upright row.

decisions.name: Weighted Triceps Dip On High Parallel Bars
decisions.reason: Triceps-style parallel-bar dip with added weight; the load does not make a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Side Lying Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: No identifiable resistance; an unloaded side-lying elbow curl is not a trainable exercise.

decisions.name: Biceps Leg Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Improvised curl using your own leg as resistance; not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Kneeling Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Floor version from the knees; the library Body Tricep Press is done standing against a bar.

instructions_en: Kneel and place your hands on the floor ahead of your shoulders, arms straight and body in a line from knees to head.
Bend your elbows to lower your forearms to the floor, keeping the elbows pointing forward.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms and return to the start.
Lie on your back with knees bent, upper arms on the floor beside you and elbows bent to 90 degrees.
Drive your elbows into the floor and squeeze your shoulder blades together to lift your chest and upper back.
Pause briefly at the top, then lower slowly with control.

decisions.name: One Arm Towel Row
decisions.reason: Kept as the one towel-row row (Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row (With Towel) points here); the library has no towel or single-arm bodyweight row.

instructions_en: Loop a towel around a sturdy post, hold both ends in one hand and lean back with your arm straight and body in a line.
Pull your chest toward your hand, driving the elbow back past your ribs.
Lower back to a straight arm under control; switch hands after the set.

decisions.name: Side Bridge Hip Abduction
decisions.reason: Leg raise performed while holding a side plank, unlike the lying side hip abduction (edb-0710).

instructions_en: Set up in a side plank on your forearm, elbow under your shoulder, body straight from head to feet.
Without letting your hips sag, raise your top leg as high as you can control, toes pointing forward.
Lower the leg slowly, finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Side Plank Hip Adduction
decisions.reason: Side plank with the top leg supported so the adductors do the work, i.e. the Copenhagen plank.

decisions.name: Farmers Walk
decisions.reason: Farmer's walk with dumbbells.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Cuban Press V. 2
decisions.reason: Source 'v. 2' of the dumbbell Cuban press.

decisions.name: Stationary Bike Run V. 3
decisions.reason: Stationary bike cycling; 'v. 3' is a source artifact.

instructions_en: Sit facing the arm ergometer with the crank axle at shoulder height and your feet flat on the floor.
Grip the handles and turn the cranks in smooth circles, pushing and pulling evenly with both arms.
Keep your torso upright and set the resistance and pace for the work interval.

decisions.name: Walk Elliptical Cross Trainer
decisions.reason: Elliptical trainer.

decisions.name: Ski Ergometer
decisions.reason: SkiErg; the same standing ski ergometer as wger 'Ski Machine'.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Around World
decisions.reason: Standing shoulder version; the library Around The Worlds is done lying on a bench.

instructions_en: Stand tall holding light dumbbells in front of your thighs, palms facing forward and arms nearly straight.
Sweep the dumbbells out to the sides and up in a wide arc until they meet overhead.
Reverse the arc slowly back to your thighs, keeping your ribs down and elbows soft.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Chest Press
decisions.reason: The library Cable Chest Press is already seated.

decisions.name: Barbell Reverse Close-Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Close underhand-grip barbell bench press = Reverse Triceps Bench Press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Triceps Extension
decisions.reason: Seated overhead extension holding one dumbbell in both hands = Seated Triceps Press.

decisions.name: Left Hook. Boxing
decisions.reason: Boxing punch (sport drill), and a left-side-only variant.

decisions.name: Lever Hip Extension V. 2
decisions.reason: Machine hip extension with the 'v. 2' suffix dropped; no machine hip extension in the library.

instructions_en: Set the machine pad behind the working thigh and stand tall on the other leg, holding the handles.
Drive the leg back by squeezing the glute until the hip is fully extended, without arching your lower back.
Return slowly to the start, finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Lever Alternate Leg Press
decisions.reason: Independent arms pressed one leg at a time; the library Leg Press moves one sled with both legs.

instructions_en: Sit in an independent-arm leg press with both feet on the plates, hip-width apart, and release the safeties.
Press one plate away until that knee is almost straight, then lower it under control.
Repeat with the other leg, alternating each rep while keeping your lower back on the pad.
Sit at the grip machine with your forearms supported and your fingers wrapped around the handles.
Squeeze the handles together as hard as you can, holding the closed position for a second.
Open your hands slowly against the resistance and repeat.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Zottman Preacher Curl
decisions.reason: Zottman curl over a preacher pad; standing at the bench does not change the movement.

decisions.name: Inverted Row On Bench
decisions.reason: Bodyweight inverted row; gripping a bench edge is only an improvised bar.

decisions.name: Inverted Row Bent Knees
decisions.reason: Bent-knee regression of the inverted row; same exercise.

decisions.name: Walking On Stepmill
decisions.reason: Step mill.

decisions.name: Lying Elbow To Knee
decisions.reason: Lying elbow-to-knee crunch.

decisions.name: Lever Rotary Calf
decisions.reason: Seated calf press with legs nearly straight = the library Calf Press machine.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Bent Arm Lateral Raise

instructions_en: Sit at the end of a bench holding dumbbells at your sides, elbows bent to 90 degrees, palms facing in.
Raise your elbows out to the sides until your upper arms are level with your shoulders, keeping the elbow angle fixed.
Lower slowly to the start without leaning or swinging.

decisions.name: Lever Shoulder Press V. 3
decisions.reason: Lever shoulder press machine; 'v. 3' is a source artifact.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Inner Biceps Curl V. 2
decisions.reason: Standing inner-biceps curl; 'v. 2' is a source artifact.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Reverse Grip Row (Female)
decisions.reason: Same underhand two-dumbbell bent-over row as wger's Dumbbell Underhand Dead Row.

decisions.name: Spine Twist
decisions.reason: Unloaded seated spinal rotation; a mobility/warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Cycle Cross Trainer
decisions.reason: Seated pedalling cardio machine with handlebars; logs as stationary cycling.

decisions.name: Arm Slingers Hanging Straight Legs
decisions.reason: Hanging straight-leg raise performed in ab slings; same movement.

decisions.name: Sled Lying Calf Press
decisions.reason: Calf press on a leg press sled.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Calf Press
decisions.reason: Seated with knees under the lever pad = Seated Calf Raise.

decisions.name: Arm Slingers Hanging Bent Knee Legs
decisions.reason: Hanging knee raise performed in ab slings; same movement.

decisions.name: Wide-Grip Chest Dip On High Parallel Bars
decisions.reason: Wide hand spacing for chest emphasis; library dips use standard bar width.

instructions_en: Support yourself on wide dip bars with arms locked, hands set wider than your shoulders.
Lean your torso forward and lower until your upper arms are about parallel to the floor, elbows flaring slightly.
Press back up to lockout, keeping the forward lean throughout.

decisions.name: Assisted Wide-Grip Chest Dip (Kneeling)
decisions.reason: Kneeling assisted dip machine; handle width on the machine is not programmed as a separate exercise.

decisions.name: Weighted Russian Twist V. 2
decisions.reason: Weighted Russian twist = Plate Twist; 'v. 2' is a source artifact.

instructions_en: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at shoulder height, palms facing forward and elbows pulled wide and back.
Press the dumbbells up and slightly outward in an arc, stopping just short of lockout.
Lower them back along the same path to shoulder height, keeping the elbows wide.

decisions.name: Close-Grip Push-Up (On Knees)
decisions.reason: Done from the knees; library and wger close-grip push-ups are on the toes.

instructions_en: Kneel and place your hands under your shoulders or slightly narrower, body straight from knees to head.
Lower your chest toward the floor, keeping your elbows tucked close to your ribs.
Press through your palms to straighten your arms, keeping your hips in line.

decisions.name: Cable Seated Twist
decisions.reason: Seated so the hips stay fixed; Cable Twist (edb-0243) and the other cable rotations are standing.

instructions_en: Sit on a bench side-on to a cable set at chest height, holding the handle with both hands, arms extended.
Keeping your hips still, rotate your torso away from the machine, pulling the handle across your body.
Return slowly to the start, finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Inverse Leg Curl (On Pull-Up Cable Machine)
decisions.reason: Kneeling with ankles under the pulldown pad and lowering forward = natural glute-ham raise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Biceps Curl (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: Dumbbell biceps curl with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Hammer Curls (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: Dumbbell hammer curl with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Alternate Biceps Curl (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: Alternating dumbbell curl with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Ez-Bar Biceps Curl (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: EZ-bar curl with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Triceps Pushdown (V-Bar) (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: V-bar pushdown with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Cable Reverse Grip Triceps Pushdown (Sz-Bar) (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: Reverse-grip bar pushdown with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Barbell Biceps Curl (With Arm Blaster)
decisions.reason: Barbell curl with an arm blaster; the accessory does not change the exercise.

decisions.name: Barbell Standing Concentration Curl
decisions.reason: Standing bent-over version; the library barbell concentration curl is seated.

instructions_en: Hold a barbell with an underhand shoulder-width grip and hinge forward until your torso is nearly parallel, arms hanging straight.
Keeping your upper arms vertical and still, curl the bar toward your forehead.
Lower slowly to full extension without letting your torso rise.

decisions.name: Frog Crunch
decisions.reason: Short-range crunch in a soles-together, knees-out leg position; Crunches uses a normal leg position and Frog Sit-Ups is a full sit-up.

instructions_en: Lie on your back, press the soles of your feet together and let your knees fall open to the sides.
With fingertips lightly behind your head, curl your shoulders off the floor by tightening your abs.
Pause briefly, then lower your shoulders slowly without pulling on your neck.

decisions.name: Ez-Bar Close-Grip Bench Press
decisions.reason: Same lying close-grip press with an EZ-bar as the library's Close-Grip EZ-Bar Press.

decisions.name: Chest Dip On Straight Bar
decisions.reason: Dip on a single straight bar in front of the body; differs from parallel-bar and chest dips.

instructions_en: Grip a straight bar overhand at shoulder width and press up to straight arms with the bar at your hips.
Lean slightly forward and bend your elbows to lower your chest toward the bar.
Press back up to straight arms, keeping your shoulders down and away from your ears.

decisions.name: Cable Thibaudeau Kayak Row
decisions.reason: Thibaudeau's alternating one-side pulldown arc; no comparable pulldown in the library.

instructions_en: Sit at a lat pulldown holding a long straight bar with a wide overhand grip, arms extended overhead.
Pull the bar down toward one side of your chest in an arc, letting it tilt like a paddle stroke.
Return to the top under control and alternate sides each rep, keeping your torso tall.

decisions.name: Bridge - Mountain Climber (Cross Body)
decisions.reason: Knee drives across to the opposite elbow, adding rotation; differs from straight Mountain Climbers.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body straight from head to heels.
Drive one knee across your body toward the opposite elbow, then return it and switch legs.
Keep alternating at a steady pace without letting your hips rise or sag.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying On Floor Rear Delt Raise
decisions.reason: Same prone dumbbell rear delt raise; lying on the floor instead of a bench is only a setup detail.

decisions.name: Seated Piriformis Stretch
decisions.reason: Seated figure-four hip stretch; no seated piriformis stretch in the library.

instructions_en: Sit tall on a bench or chair and rest one ankle across the opposite knee.
Keeping your back straight, hinge forward from the hips until you feel a stretch deep in the crossed leg's hip.
Hold while breathing slowly, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Rocking Frog Stretch
decisions.reason: Frog Stretch with a gentle rocking motion; same position and target, the rocking adds nothing material.

decisions.name: Lever Horizontal One Leg Press
decisions.reason: Single-leg version on a horizontal (seated) leg press; the library only has two-leg presses and the 45-degree sled single-leg press is a different machine.

instructions_en: Sit in a horizontal leg press with your back against the pad and one foot centred on the platform.
Release the safety and bend your knee toward your chest, keeping your hips and lower back on the seat.
Press the platform away through your whole foot until the knee is almost straight; finish the set, then switch legs.

decisions.name: Jump Rope
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library's Rope Jumping.

decisions.name: Cable Lateral Pulldown With V-Bar
decisions.reason: Lat pulldown with a V-bar handle, the same as V-Bar Pulldown.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Pronation On Floor
decisions.reason: Same lying dumbbell forearm pronation; floor instead of bench is only a setup detail.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Lying Supination On Floor
decisions.reason: Same lying dumbbell forearm supination; floor instead of bench is only a setup detail.

decisions.name: Lever Reverse Grip Lateral Pulldown
decisions.reason: Plate-loaded machine reverse-grip pulldown, the same as Reverse Grip Machine Lat Pulldown.

decisions.name: Ez-Barbell Standing Wide Grip Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: The wide (outer-bend) grip is the standard EZ-Bar Curl grip; standing is the default.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Step-Up Lunge
decisions.reason: Forward lunge landing on a raised step and pushing back; Dumbbell Step Ups climb fully onto the box.

instructions_en: Stand a long stride behind a low step, holding a dumbbell in each hand at your sides.
Lunge forward, planting your front foot on the step, and lower until your back knee nearly touches the floor.
Push through the front foot to return to standing, then repeat or alternate legs.

decisions.name: Barbell Sitted Alternate Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Unclear barbell variant of a seated alternating leg raise; cannot be identified with confidence and looks gimmicky.

decisions.name: Barbell Sitted Alternate Leg Raise (Female)
decisions.reason: Female-model duplicate of an unclear barbell seated leg raise variant.

decisions.name: Twisted Leg Raise (Female)
decisions.reason: Female-model copy of Twisted Leg Raise; adds only noise.

decisions.name: Twisted Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Lying leg raise with hip rotation for the obliques; its closest match is the female-model copy, which is excluded.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with arms out to the sides, palms down, legs straight and together.
Raise your legs toward vertical while rotating your hips so your feet travel toward one side.
Lower slowly back to centre just above the floor and alternate sides each rep.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Supported Squat
decisions.reason: Dumbbell squat with a hand support only; near-identical noise variant of Dumbbell Squat.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single Leg Deadlift With Stepbox Support
decisions.reason: Stepbox support adds nothing material; Dumbbell Single-Leg Romanian Deadlift covers it.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Sumo Pull Through
decisions.reason: Wide-stance dumbbell hip hinge pulled between the legs; the library's Pull Through is a cable exercise.

instructions_en: Stand in a wide stance, toes turned out, holding one dumbbell by its end with both hands at arm's length.
Push your hips back and let the dumbbell travel back between your legs, keeping your back flat and knees soft.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall and squeeze your glutes, without swinging the weight above hip height.

decisions.name: Barbell Split Squat V. 2
decisions.reason: Standard front-to-back barbell split squat (source suffix dropped); Barbell Side Split Squat is a lateral variant and no plain barbell split squat exists.

instructions_en: Set a barbell across your upper back and take a long split stance, front foot flat and back heel raised.
Lower straight down by bending both knees until the back knee nearly touches the floor, torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to return to the top; complete all reps before switching legs.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Step-Up Split Squat
decisions.reason: Front foot on a step increases depth; a named variant distinct from the flat Split Squat with Dumbbells.

instructions_en: Hold dumbbells at your sides and place your front foot on a low step, back foot a long stride behind.
Lower straight down until your back knee nearly touches the floor, keeping your torso upright.
Drive through the front foot to stand back up; finish all reps before switching legs.

decisions.name: Captains Chair Straight Leg Raise
decisions.reason: Kept as the one row of the captain's chair cluster (Vertical Leg Raise on parallel bars and wger Leg Raises, Standing point here); the library has the hanging and lying leg raises only.

instructions_en: Stand in a captain's chair with your forearms on the pads, back against the backrest and legs hanging straight.
Keep your legs straight and raise them until they are level with your hips, without swinging.
Lower them slowly back to hanging and repeat.

decisions.name: Weighted Close Grip Chin-Up On Dip Cage
decisions.reason: Loaded close-grip chin-up; the library tracks weighted bodyweight lifts separately (as with Weighted Pull Ups). 'On dip cage' dropped as setup noise.

instructions_en: Add weight with a dip belt or vest and hang from a bar with an underhand grip, hands closer than shoulder width.
Pull your chest toward the bar by driving your elbows down until your chin clears it.
Lower to a full hang under control without letting the weight swing.

decisions.name: Ez Bar Lying Bent Arms Pullover
decisions.reason: EZ-bar version of the bent-arm pullover; the library keeps EZ-bar lifts separate from straight-bar ones.

instructions_en: Lie on a flat bench holding an EZ-bar over your chest with a narrow grip and elbows slightly bent.
Keeping the elbow bend fixed, lower the bar back past your head in an arc until your lats stretch.
Pull the bar back over your chest along the same arc, keeping your lower back on the bench.

decisions.name: Scapula Dips
decisions.reason: Straight-arm shoulder-blade depression on dip bars; unlike Dips, the elbows never bend.

instructions_en: Support yourself on parallel bars with arms locked straight and let your shoulders rise so your body sinks slightly.
Without bending your elbows, push your shoulders down away from your ears to lift your body a few centimetres.
Pause at the top, then let your shoulders rise slowly back to the start.

decisions.name: Low Glute Bridge On Floor
decisions.reason: A floor glute bridge, the same as Butt Lift (Bridge).

decisions.name: Curl-Up
decisions.reason: Curl-up is another name for the basic crunch.

decisions.name: Bench Pull-Ups
decisions.reason: Ambiguous name (row under a bench or feet-on-bench pull-up); Inverted Row and Inverted Row On Bench already cover it.

decisions.name: Potty Squat
decisions.reason: A deep bodyweight squat; same as Bodyweight Squat.

decisions.name: Potty Squat With Support
decisions.reason: Supported version of a deep bodyweight squat; the hand support only adds noise.

decisions.name: Smith Sumo Squat
decisions.reason: Wide sumo stance shifts work toward adductors and glutes; a stance variant of Smith Machine Squat.

instructions_en: Set the Smith bar on your upper back and take a wide stance, toes turned out, feet slightly ahead of the bar.
Unrack and sit straight down, pushing your knees out over your toes until your thighs are about parallel.
Drive up through your heels to stand, keeping your chest up, then rack the bar safely.

decisions.name: Push-Up Plus
decisions.reason: Adds an extra shoulder-blade protraction at the top for the serratus; a named variant of the push-up.

instructions_en: Set up in a high plank with hands under your shoulders and body in a straight line.
Perform a normal push-up, lowering your chest toward the floor and pressing back up.
At the top, push the floor away further so your shoulder blades spread apart, then repeat.

decisions.name: Pelvic Tilt
decisions.reason: Lying supine version done for core control; Standing Pelvic Tilt is upright and Pelvic Tilt Into Bridge lifts the hips.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet flat on the floor hip-width apart and arms at your sides.
Tighten your abs and tilt your pelvis so your lower back presses flat into the floor.
Hold briefly, then relax back to a neutral spine without lifting your hips.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing Close-Grip One Arm Row
decisions.reason: Close grip on a one-arm pole row is meaningless; noise variant of the single-arm standing row.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing Close-Grip Row
decisions.reason: Hand spacing on an upright post adds nothing; near-identical variant of Bodyweight Mid Row.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row (With Towel)
decisions.reason: Standing single-arm row with a towel looped around a post, the same as One Arm Towel Row.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing One Arm Row
decisions.reason: One-arm, bare-hand version of the standing post row; Bodyweight Mid Row is two-handed and One Arm Towel Row uses a towel grip.

instructions_en: Stand facing a sturdy upright post or door frame and grip it with one hand at chest height, feet close to its base.
Lean back until your arm is straight, then pull your chest toward your hand by driving the elbow back.
Lower yourself slowly to a straight arm; finish the set and switch sides.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing Row (With Towel)
decisions.reason: Towel looped around a post on a two-hand standing row; minor handle change that only adds noise to Bodyweight Mid Row.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Standing Row
decisions.reason: Two-hand standing row leaning back from an upright post, the same as Bodyweight Mid Row.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Squatting Row (With Towel)
decisions.reason: Towel copy of the squatting post row; adds noise.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Squatting Row
decisions.reason: Post row performed from a deep squat, changing body position and pull angle versus the standing Bodyweight Mid Row; the towel copy is excluded.

instructions_en: Grip a sturdy upright post or door frame with both hands at chest height and sink into a deep squat facing it.
Lean back until your arms are straight, then pull your chest toward your hands, squeezing your shoulder blades.
Lower back to straight arms with control, staying low in the squat throughout.

decisions.name: Glute-Ham Raise
decisions.reason: Same exercise as the library's Glute Ham Raise.

decisions.name: Lever Lying Two-One Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Named eccentric-overload technique (lift with two legs, lower with one); differs from a standard Lying Leg Curl.

row.name_en: Machine Lying Two-Up One-Down Leg Curl
instructions_en: Lie face down on a leg curl machine with the pad just above your heels and knees just past the bench edge.
Curl the pad up with both legs, then lift one leg away and lower the weight slowly with the other.
Bring both legs back to the pad at the bottom and alternate the lowering leg each rep.

decisions.name: Lever Bent-Over Row With V-Bar
decisions.reason: Standing plate-loaded T-bar row with a V-handle; same movement as T-Bar Row with Handle (T-bar maps to barbell).

decisions.name: Quarter Sit-Up
decisions.reason: A quarter-range sit-up is a crunch.

decisions.name: Half Sit-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Partial-range sit-up; same as 3/4 Sit-Up (model label dropped).

decisions.name: Prisoner Half Sit-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Partial-range sit-up with hands behind the head; hand position only.

decisions.name: Arms Overhead Full Sit-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Full sit-up with arms overhead; arm position only.

decisions.name: Kneeling Push-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Same as knee push-ups (model label dropped).

decisions.name: Basic Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Same as Standing Toe Touches.

decisions.name: Side-To-Side Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Dynamic side-to-side toe touching is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Arms Apart Circular Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Circular toe-touch is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Hands Reversed Clasped Circular Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Circular toe-touch with clasped hands is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Chest Tap Push-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Push-up with an alternating hand tap at the top; tapping the chest instead of the shoulder is the same anti-rotation push-up.

decisions.name: Modified Hindu Push-Up (Male)
decisions.reason: Same flowing Hindu push-up pattern; 'modified' adds nothing identifiable.

decisions.name: Hands Clasped Circular Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Circular toe-touch with clasped hands is a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Scissor Jumps (Male)
decisions.reason: Same as Scissors Jump.

decisions.name: Astride Jumps (Male)
decisions.reason: Astride jumps are jumping jacks.

decisions.name: Half Knee Bends (Male)
decisions.reason: Half knee bends are a warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Semi Squat Jump (Male)
decisions.reason: Plyometric jump; plyometrics are not imported.

decisions.name: Star Jump (Male)
decisions.reason: Same as Star Jump (model label dropped).

decisions.name: Jack Jump (Male)
decisions.reason: Jack jump is the jumping jack.

decisions.name: Two Toe Touch (Male)
decisions.reason: Touching both toes from standing is the standard toe touch.

decisions.name: Hyght Dumbbell Fly
decisions.reason: 'Hyght' is not a recognisable term; the variant cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Cable Assisted Inverse Leg Curl
decisions.reason: Nordic curl with adjustable cable assistance; a scalable regression of the bodyweight glute-ham raise.

instructions_en: Kneel on a pad facing away from a cable stack with ankles secured, holding a handle from a mid pulley at your chest.
Keeping hips extended, slowly lower your torso forward with your hamstrings while the cable takes some load.
Pull yourself back up with your hamstrings; add stack weight for more assistance.

decisions.name: Landmine Lateral Raise
decisions.reason: Single-arm lateral raise using a landmine arc; no landmine raise in the library.

instructions_en: Stand side-on to a landmine and hold the bar end with the hand farther from the anchor, starting in front of your opposite hip.
With a slight elbow bend, raise the bar up and out across your body until your hand reaches shoulder height.
Lower slowly along the same arc; complete the set before switching sides.

decisions.name: Kneeling Plank Tap Shoulder (Male)
decisions.reason: Kneeling regression of the plank shoulder tap; body position differs from the full plank version.

instructions_en: Start in a high plank on your knees, hands under shoulders and body straight from head to knees.
Lift one hand and tap the opposite shoulder, keeping your hips square and still.
Return the hand to the floor and alternate sides with control.

decisions.name: Smith Full Squat
decisions.reason: A full-depth Smith squat is the Smith Machine Squat.

decisions.name: Elbow Dips
decisions.reason: Niche calisthenics dip-to-forearm transition with an unclear name; not something to program in a gym.

decisions.name: Korean Dips
decisions.reason: Dip on a straight bar held behind the body; a distinct calisthenics dip, not the standard parallel-bar dip.

instructions_en: Stand with your back to a straight bar at hip height and grip it behind you, hands shoulder-width apart.
Jump to straight arms with the bar behind your hips, then bend your elbows and let your body move forward and down.
Lower only as far as your shoulders allow, then press back up to straight arms.

decisions.name: Impossible Dips
decisions.reason: Gimmicky elite dip variant; not something to program in a gym.

decisions.name: Weighted One Hand Pull Up
decisions.reason: Weighted one-arm pull-up is an elite stunt; One Arm Chin-Up covers single-arm pulling.

decisions.name: Stalder Press
decisions.reason: Elite gymnastics press-to-handstand skill; not something to program in a gym.

decisions.name: Elevator
decisions.reason: 'Elevator' is not identifiable with confidence as a specific exercise.

decisions.name: Archer Push Up
decisions.reason: Wide-hand push-up shifting the load onto one arm; a named progression toward the single-arm push-up.

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position with hands set very wide and fingers turned slightly out.
Shift your weight to one side and lower your chest toward that hand, keeping the other arm nearly straight.
Press back to the centre and alternate sides, keeping your body in a straight line.

decisions.name: Front Lever Reps
decisions.reason: Dynamic straight-arm raise into the front lever, distinct from the static hold.

instructions_en: Hang from a bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and arms locked straight.
Keeping arms straight and body rigid, pull the bar toward your hips to raise your body until it is horizontal.
Lower back to the hang slowly; tuck your knees if full extension is too hard.

decisions.name: Front Lever
decisions.reason: Same static front lever hold.

decisions.name: Back Lever
decisions.reason: Static straight-arm gymnastics hold, face down behind the arms; unrelated to its closest match Elbows Back.

instructions_en: Hang from rings or a bar, tuck your knees and rotate backward until your body hangs behind your arms.
Extend to horizontal, face down, with arms straight and hips locked so your body forms one line.
Hold for time, then tuck and rotate back to the start under control.

decisions.name: Straddle Planche
decisions.reason: Straddle-leg planche progression; unrelated to its closest match The Straddle (a stretch).

instructions_en: Place your hands on the floor or parallettes shoulder-width apart, fingers slightly out, arms locked.
Lean your shoulders forward past your hands and lift your legs into a wide straddle with your body horizontal.
Hold with shoulders pushed away from the floor and hips level, then lower your feet with control.

decisions.name: Full Planche
decisions.reason: Full straight-body planche hold; the end goal of the planche progressions.

instructions_en: Set your hands on the floor or parallettes, arms straight, and lean your shoulders well forward of your hands.
Lift your legs together behind you until your whole body is horizontal and straight, supported only by your hands.
Hold while pushing the floor away and squeezing your glutes, then lower your feet with control.

decisions.name: Lean Planche
decisions.reason: Feet-supported planche lean, the entry-level planche drill.

instructions_en: Start in a push-up position with arms straight and fingers turned slightly out.
Shift your shoulders forward past your hands while keeping arms locked and body straight, toes on the floor.
Hold the lean with shoulders pushed away from the floor, then shift back to the start.

decisions.name: Frog Planche
decisions.reason: Frog planche is the frog stand: knees braced on the elbows with feet off the floor.

decisions.name: Flag
decisions.reason: Sideways body hold on a vertical pole; unrelated to the Dragon Flag.

instructions_en: Grip a vertical pole with both hands wider than shoulder width, top hand overhand and bottom hand underhand.
Push hard with the bottom arm and pull with the top arm to lift your legs off the ground sideways.
Hold your body as horizontal as possible with legs together, then lower your feet with control.

decisions.name: Skin The Cat
decisions.reason: Gymnastics hanging rotation through the arms; no comparable exercise in the library.

instructions_en: Hang from rings or a bar with straight arms, then tuck your knees to your chest.
Pull your legs through your arms and rotate backward until you hang with your body behind you.
Reverse the rotation slowly to return to the hang without letting go.

decisions.name: Weighted Muscle Up (On Bar)
decisions.reason: A muscle-up with added weight; the log records the weight, so it stays the library's Muscle Up.

decisions.name: Weighted Straight Bar Dip
decisions.reason: A straight bar dip with added weight; the log records the weight, so it stays Straight Bar Dip.

decisions.name: Straddle Maltese
decisions.reason: Elite gymnastics Maltese skill; not something to program in a gym.

decisions.name: Full Maltese
decisions.reason: Elite gymnastics Maltese skill; not something to program in a gym.

decisions.name: Swing 360
decisions.reason: Bar swing trick, not a programmable gym exercise.

decisions.name: Full Planche Push-Up
decisions.reason: Elite gymnastics feat; Full Planche and the pseudo planche push-up cover planche training.

decisions.name: Bear Crawl
decisions.reason: Bodyweight crawl; only the sled-drag version exists in the library.

instructions_en: Start on hands and toes with knees bent just off the floor, back flat and hands under your shoulders.
Crawl forward by moving one hand and the opposite foot together in short steps, keeping knees low.
Keep your hips level and core tight; crawl backward to return if space is short.

decisions.name: Skater Hops
decisions.reason: Lateral plyometric bounds; plyometrics are not imported.

decisions.name: L-Pull-Up
decisions.reason: Pull-up with legs held in an L throughout, adding a large core demand; differs from Weighted Pull Ups.

instructions_en: Hang from a bar with an overhand, shoulder-width grip and raise your straight legs to hip height in an L.
Pull your chest toward the bar while keeping your legs level and still.
Lower to a full hang under control without letting your legs drop.

decisions.name: L-Sit On Floor
decisions.reason: Same L-sit hold; floor vs bars is only a setup detail.

decisions.name: V-Sit On Floor
decisions.reason: Static V-shaped balance hold; the candidate V Up is a dynamic rep.

instructions_en: Sit on the floor with knees bent, then lean back slightly and balance on your sit bones.
Straighten your legs and lift them so your torso and legs form a V, arms reaching forward.
Hold with your chest up and back straight, then lower your feet with control.

decisions.name: Swimmer Kicks V. 2 (Male)
decisions.reason: Prone alternating leg kicks, the same as the library's Flutter Kicks.

decisions.name: Forward Lunge (Male)
decisions.reason: Plain bodyweight forward lunge; '(Male)' is a source suffix.

decisions.name: Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench (Male)
decisions.reason: Heels on a bench raise the hips' range compared with the floor glute bridge.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your heels on a flat bench, knees bent about 90 degrees, arms on the floor.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until shoulders, hips and knees line up.
Pause briefly, then lower your hips under control without resting them on the floor.

decisions.name: Quads
decisions.reason: Name is just a muscle group; the exercise cannot be identified.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline T-Raise
decisions.reason: Straight-arm T-shaped raise lying prone on an incline for the mid back, unlike the generic incline raise.

instructions_en: Lie face down on a bench set to 30-45 degrees, a light dumbbell in each hand, arms hanging straight.
With thumbs pointing up, raise your straight arms out to the sides until your body forms a T.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top, then lower slowly.

decisions.name: Bodyweight Incline Side Plank
decisions.reason: Forearm on a bench makes it an easier, angled regression of the floor side plank.

instructions_en: Place one forearm on a bench under your shoulder and extend your legs to the side, feet stacked on the floor.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from head to heels.
Hold with hips high and core braced, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Incline Alternate Press
decisions.reason: One arm presses while the other holds lockout; alternating variant of the incline dumbbell press.

instructions_en: Sit on a bench set to 30-45 degrees and press both dumbbells up over your upper chest.
Lower one dumbbell to chest level while the other arm stays straight, then press it back up.
Alternate arms each rep, keeping your shoulder blades pinned and feet planted.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Alternate Shoulder
decisions.reason: Truncated name for the seated alternating dumbbell shoulder press.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Seated Biceps Curl To Shoulder Press
decisions.reason: Seated version of the curl-to-press combination; seated changes body position from the standing one.

instructions_en: Sit on an upright bench holding dumbbells at your sides, palms facing forward.
Curl the dumbbells to your shoulders, rotate your palms forward and press them overhead.
Lower to your shoulders, then uncurl to the start under control.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Single Arm Overhead Carry
