decisions.reason: Overhead loaded carry; the library only has the suitcase carry.

instructions_en: Press a dumbbell overhead with one arm and lock the elbow, biceps close to your ear.
Walk forward with short, steady steps, keeping your ribs down and torso upright.
Carry for the set distance or time, then switch arms.

decisions.name: Quick Feet V. 2
decisions.reason: Agility footwork drill, and a 'V. 2' source variant.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Standing Alternate Hammer Curl And Press
decisions.reason: Neutral-grip, alternating curl-to-press combination; differs in grip from the standard curl to press.

row.name_en: Dumbbell Alternating Hammer Curl to Press
instructions_en: Stand holding dumbbells at your sides with palms facing your body.
Hammer curl one dumbbell to your shoulder, then press it overhead keeping the palm facing in.
Reverse the path back to your side and repeat with the other arm.

decisions.name: Glute Bridge March
decisions.reason: Holds the bridge while alternately lifting each foot, adding single-leg and anti-rotation demand.

instructions_en: Lie on your back, knees bent and feet flat, and lift your hips into a bridge.
Keeping your hips level and high, lift one foot a few inches off the floor, then set it down.
Alternate legs in a slow march without letting your hips drop or rotate.

decisions.name: Barbell Glute Bridge Two Legs On Bench (Male)
decisions.reason: Heels on a bench, unlike the floor barbell glute bridge.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with your heels on a bench and a padded barbell across your hips.
Drive through your heels and squeeze your glutes to lift your hips until thighs and torso line up.
Pause at the top, then lower your hips under control.

decisions.name: Cable One Arm Pulldown
decisions.reason: Same single-arm cable lat pulldown.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Contralateral Forward Lunge
decisions.reason: Single dumbbell held on the opposite side gives an offset-loaded lunge, unlike two-dumbbell lunges.

instructions_en: Stand tall holding one dumbbell at your side, in the hand opposite the leg that will step forward.
Step forward and lower until both knees bend about 90 degrees, resisting the offset load with an upright torso.
Push through the front heel to return, finish the set, then switch hand and leg.

decisions.name: High Knee Against Wall
decisions.reason: Sprint mechanics wall drill, not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Wheel Run
decisions.reason: Running technique drill with an unclear name.

decisions.name: Push To Run
decisions.reason: Sprint start drill, not a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Bent Knee Lying Twist (Male)
decisions.reason: Supine knee-drop twist stretch; no lying spinal twist exists in the library.

instructions_en: Lie on your back with knees bent, feet together, and arms spread out to the sides.
Lower both knees to one side while keeping your shoulders flat on the floor.
Hold the stretch while breathing slowly, then bring the knees back up and switch sides.

decisions.name: Knee Touch Crunch
decisions.reason: A standard crunch; reaching to the knees is only a hand cue.

decisions.name: Weighted Kneeling Step With Swing
decisions.reason: Gimmicky kneeling-to-step swing combination nobody would program.

decisions.name: Weighted Stretch Lunge
decisions.reason: Vague name; the movement cannot be identified with confidence.

decisions.name: Weighted Cossack Squats (Male)
decisions.reason: Cossack squat with a held weight; same movement and equipment class.

decisions.name: Weighted Lunge With Swing
decisions.reason: Gimmicky lunge-and-swing combination.

decisions.name: Single Leg Bridge With Outstretched Leg
decisions.reason: Single-leg glute bridge; the free-leg position is a minor detail.

decisions.name: Walking High Knees Lunge
decisions.reason: Dynamic warm-up drill.

decisions.name: Short Stride Run
decisions.reason: Running technique drill; plain running is covered elsewhere.

decisions.name: Pike-To-Cobra Push-Up
decisions.reason: Pike-to-cobra swoop is the Hindu push-up.

decisions.name: Reverse Plank With Leg Lift
decisions.reason: Single-leg lift adds an unstable support to the reverse plank.

instructions_en: Sit with legs straight and hands on the floor behind your hips, fingers pointing toward your feet.
Lift your hips until your body forms a straight line from shoulders to heels.
Raise one straight leg a few inches, hold briefly, lower it and alternate sides, keeping hips level.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Side Plank With Rear Fly
decisions.reason: Rear delt fly performed while holding a side plank.

row.name_en: Dumbbell Side Plank with Rear Fly
instructions_en: Set up in a side plank on one forearm, holding a light dumbbell in your free hand in front of your chest.
Keeping your hips high, raise the dumbbell up and back in an arc until your arm points at the ceiling.
Lower slowly to the start, finish the set, then switch sides.

decisions.name: Power Point Plank
decisions.reason: Unclear source name; the plank variant cannot be identified.

decisions.name: Walking On Incline Treadmill
decisions.reason: Treadmill walking; incline is a machine setting.

decisions.name: Side Lying Hip Adduction (Male)
decisions.reason: Bodyweight floor adduction; the library only has cable and machine adduction.

instructions_en: Lie on your side, bottom leg straight, and cross the top leg over so its foot rests on the floor in front.
Lift the straight bottom leg toward the ceiling using your inner thigh.
Pause at the top, then lower slowly without resting the leg on the floor.

decisions.name: Standing Archer
decisions.reason: Unclear mobility drill; cannot be identified as a gym exercise.

decisions.name: Ski Step
decisions.reason: Lateral agility hop drill.

decisions.name: Back And Forth Step
decisions.reason: Agility stepping drill.

decisions.name: Sit-Up With Arms On Chest
decisions.reason: Standard sit-up; crossed arms is a minor detail.

decisions.name: Cable Kneeling Rear Delt Row (With Rope) (Male)
decisions.reason: Same rope rear-delt row; kneeling only adjusts the pulley line.

decisions.name: Inchworm V. 2
decisions.reason: Inchworm; 'V. 2' is a source variant.

decisions.name: Shoulder Tap
decisions.reason: Plank shoulder taps.

decisions.name: Lever Standing Chest Press
decisions.reason: Standing lever press; the leverage chest press is seated.

instructions_en: Stand facing away from the machine, grip the handles at chest height and stagger your feet.
Brace your core and press the handles forward until your arms are nearly straight.
Return slowly until your hands are beside your chest.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Good Morning
decisions.reason: Lever machine version; the library seated good morning uses a barbell.

instructions_en: Sit in the machine with the pad across your upper back, feet secured and spine neutral.
Hinge forward from the hips under control, keeping your back flat and chest up.
Drive your torso back to upright by squeezing your glutes and hamstrings.

decisions.name: Lever Seated Crunch V. 2
decisions.reason: Seated machine crunch; 'V. 2' is a source variant.

decisions.name: Curtsey Squat
decisions.reason: Crossover step-back lunge, not a bilateral squat.

instructions_en: Stand tall with feet hip-width apart and hands at your chest or hips.
Step one leg diagonally behind the other and lower until the front thigh is nearly parallel to the floor.
Push through the front heel to stand, then repeat on the other side.

decisions.name: Incline Push-Up (On Box)
decisions.reason: Incline push-up; a box instead of a bench is a minor detail.

decisions.name: Dumbbell One Arm Snatch
decisions.reason: Kept as the one dumbbell snatch row (Liftosaur's Dumbbell Snatch points here); the library's snatches are barbell lifts.

instructions_en: Stand with a dumbbell on the floor between your feet, hinge and grip it with one hand, back flat.
Drive through your legs and extend your hips explosively, pulling the dumbbell up close to your body.
Punch it overhead to a straight arm in one movement, then lower it to the floor with control.

decisions.name: Dumbbell Waiter Biceps Curl
decisions.reason: Both hands cup one vertical dumbbell; a distinct grip from the standard dumbbell curl.

instructions_en: Stand holding one dumbbell vertically, both palms flat under the top plate, elbows at your sides.
Curl the dumbbell toward your shoulders, keeping it upright and your elbows still.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
